sentence1: The energy label for room air conditioners This label provides information about the energy efficiency of the declared appliances . When we buy a new small air conditioner , it is not only the purchase price that counts , but also the associated long - term electricity costs . With this label it is possible to identify the most energy - efficient models at a glance . The benefits of small air conditioners vary enormously . Cheap models are often practically ineffective , since they release warm air into the room \u2013 and some models are also very noisy . Instead of buying such appliances , there are other simple ways of keeping cool during periods of hot weather : shading windows , turning off unused appliances and lights ( sources of heat ! ) , airing rooms thoroughly in the morning , then keeping the windows closed . Ventilators are relatively inexpensive and consume less energy than air conditioning units , and they keep the air flowing and thus help cool the room . sentence2: L\u2019\u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie pour les climatiseurs L ' \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie d ' un appareil d\u00e9livre des informations sur son rendement \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique . Le co\u00fbt d ' un appareil n ' est pas uniquement son prix d ' achat . Il faut aussi prendre en compte son co\u00fbt d ' utilisation \u00e0 long terme , soit le co\u00fbt de l ' \u00e9nergie consomm\u00e9e . Un simple coup d ' \u0153il sur l ' \u00e9tiquette suffira \u00e0 vous renseigner . L ' utilit\u00e9 des petits climatiseurs est tr\u00e8s variable . Les appareils bon march\u00e9 sont le plus souvent presque totalement inefficaces , puisqu ' ils rejettent de la chaleur dans la pi\u00e8ce tout en \u00e9tant bruyants . Plut\u00f4t que d ' acheter un tel appareil , des mesures simples peuvent \u00eatre prises pour passer les p\u00e9riodes de fortes chaleurs en gardant la t\u00eate froide : prot\u00e9ger les fen\u00eatres du soleil , \u00e9teindre les appareils et les lampes inutilis\u00e9s ( qui g\u00e9n\u00e8rent de la chaleur ) , a\u00e9rer massivement aux premi\u00e8res heures du jour , maintenir ensuite les fen\u00eatres ferm\u00e9es . Les ventilateurs sont relativement peu chers et moins gourmands en \u00e9nergie que les petits climatiseurs ; ils provoquent un d\u00e9placement d ' air synonyme de fra\u00eecheur . Documents Fiche d ' informations Aide \u00e0 l\u2019application des prescriptions concernant les installations et appareils conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 l\u2019ordonnance sur les exigences relatives \u00e0 l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( OEEE ) Liens SuisseEnergie - Acheter un appareil adapt\u00e9 \u00e0 ses besoins et l\u2019utiliser de fa\u00e7on optimale Mod\u00e8les pour \u00e9tiquettes - \u00e9nergie Droit Article 89 de la Constitution f\u00e9d\u00e9rale - Politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique Article 44 de la loi sur l\u2019\u00e9nergie ( LEne ) Ordonnance sur les exigences relatives \u00e0 l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique du 1er novembre 2017 ( OEEE ) Exigences d\u00e9taill\u00e9es Ordonnance sur les exigences relatives \u00e0 l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( OEEE ) , annexe 1 . 13 R\u00e8glement ( UE ) No 206 / 2012 de la Commission du 6 mars 2012 R\u00e8glement d\u00e9l\u00e9gu\u00e9 ( UE ) N\u00b0 626 / 2011 du 4 mai 2011 Contact sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 Derni\u00e8re modification 15 . 05 . 2020

sentence1: Access to official documents It is possible to gain access to official SFOE documents under the Freedom of Information Act . This applies to documents produced after 1 July 2006 . There is no complicated procedure for requesting access \u2013 a written request is not required . You just need to provide enough information for us to identify the document requested . Give as much information as possible : the date the document was created , the title or references , the exact subject domain and the time period it refers to are all useful . The SFOE may ask you to provide greater precision if your request is not detailed enough or if you are asking for multiple documents . We will respond to the request within 20 days . This period may be extended , in which case you will be informed . The procedure for accessing official documents is governed by the Freedom of Information Act and the associated ordinance . Contact You can apply for access to official documents in writing by email or post using the form attached below . However , as mentioned above , a request for access can also be submitted informally ( via ) . sentence2: Acc\u00e8s aux documents officiels En vertu de la loi sur la transparence ( Ltrans ) , vous pouvez demander \u00e0 consulter les documents officiels de l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie ( OFEN ) . Ce droit d\u2019acc\u00e8s s\u2019applique aux documents finalis\u00e9s apr\u00e8s le 1er juillet 2006 . Une demande d\u2019acc\u00e8s peut \u00eatre adress\u00e9e de mani\u00e8re informelle , y compris de mani\u00e8re orale . Elle doit contenir suffisamment d\u2019informations pour que l\u2019OFEN puisse identifier les documents que vous souhaitez consulter . Veuillez donc lui transmettre le plus de d\u00e9tails possibles concernant ces documents . Il peut \u00eatre utile d\u2019indiquer la date d\u2019\u00e9tablissement , le titre , les r\u00e9f\u00e9rences , le domaine pr\u00e9cis ou la p\u00e9riode concern\u00e9e . Si votre requ\u00eate est tr\u00e8s vaste ou insuffisamment d\u00e9finie , l\u2019OFEN peut exiger que vous pr\u00e9cisiez votre demande . L\u2019OFEN prend position sur les demandes d\u2019acc\u00e8s dans un d\u00e9lai de 20 jours . Ce d\u00e9lai peut \u00eatre prolong\u00e9 . Si tel est le cas pour les documents que vous souhaitez consultez , l\u2019OFEN vous en informera . La proc\u00e9dure d\u2019acc\u00e8s aux documents officiels est r\u00e9gl\u00e9e dans la LTrans et dans l\u2019ordonnance sur la transparence . Contact Vous pouvez nous transmettre votre demande par \u00e9crit , soit par courriel soit par courrier postal , via le formulaire disponible sous le lien ci - apr\u00e8s . Comme pr\u00e9cis\u00e9 ci - avant , il vous est \u00e9galement possible de nous l\u2019adresser de mani\u00e8re informelle , sans utiliser le formulaire ( via ) . Documents Formulaire \u00abDemande d ' acc\u00e8s aux documents officiels\u00bb Liens Base de donn\u00e9es Publications Droit Loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale du 17 d\u00e9cembre 2004 sur le principe de la transparence dans l ' administration ( Loi sur la transparence , LTrans ) Ordonnance du 24 mai 2006 sur le principe de la transparence dans l\u2019administration ( Ordonnance sur la transparence , OTrans ) Derni\u00e8re modification 21 . 08 . 2024

sentence1: Nuclear energy In Switzerland , nuclear energy is used solely for peaceful purposes , i . e . for producing electricity and for applications in medicine , industry and research . Its use was initiated here in May 1957 when the first research reactor was put into operation . In the early 1960s , in view of the fact that the existing hydropower capacities were already largely exhausted , the Federal Council resolved to develop the use of nuclear energy in order to meet the rapidly growing demand for electricity . Nuclear power plants in operation in Switzerland Map showing Switzerland\u2019s nuclear power plants The commercial use of nuclear energy was initiated in 1969 with the handover for operation of Beznau I nuclear power plant . Beznau II and M\u00fchleberg were commissioned in 1972 , followed by G\u00f6sgen in 1979 and Leibstadt in 1984 . In 2008 , the operators of Switzerland\u2019s nuclear power plants submitted three applications for the construction of new nuclear power plants . In the wake of the accident at the Japanese Fukushima Dai - ichi nuclear power plant , in March 2011 the Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) decided to suspend the ongoing general licence applications for new nuclear power plants . In the course of that year , the resolutions by the Federal Council and Parliament to withdraw from the use of nuclear energy on a step - by - step basis resulted in the formulation of a new federal energy policy ( Energy Strategy 2050 ) . The nuclear power plant operators withdrew their three applications at the end of 2016 . In May 2017 , the Swiss electorate accepted the revised Federal Energy Act upon the publication of the initial package of measures for Energy Strategy 2050 . The granting of new general licences for nuclear power plants was prohibited with effect from 1 January 2018 . M\u00fchleberg nuclear power plant was shut down in December 2019 and is currently being dismantled . Switzerland\u2019s other nuclear power plants are still in operation . In Switzerland there is no legally specified duration of the service life of nuclear power plants . They may continue to be operated as long as they are safe . sentence2: Energie nucl\u00e9aire En Suisse , l ' \u00e9nergie nucl\u00e9aire n ' est utilis\u00e9e qu ' \u00e0 des fins pacifiques , autrement dit pour produire de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 ainsi que dans les domaines de la m\u00e9decine , de l ' industrie et de la recherche . L\u2019utilisation de l\u2019\u00e9nergie nucl\u00e9aire remonte \u00e0 mai 1957 lorsque le premier r\u00e9acteur nucl\u00e9aire d\u00e9di\u00e9 \u00e0 la recherche est mis en service . Au d\u00e9but des ann\u00e9es 1960 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral se prononce en faveur de l\u2019\u00e9nergie nucl\u00e9aire au d\u00e9triment de l\u2019\u00e9nergie hydraulique , d\u00e9j\u00e0 largement exploit\u00e9e . L\u2019objectif \u00e9tait de couvrir la demande d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 en forte hausse \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9poque . Centrales nucl\u00e9aires suisses Carte Centrales nucl\u00e9aires L\u2019utilisation \u00e0 des fins commerciales de l\u2019\u00e9nergie nucl\u00e9aire d\u00e9bute en 1969 avec la mise en service de la centrale nucl\u00e9aire de Beznau I , suivie de Beznau II et de M\u00fchleberg en 1972 , de G\u00f6sgen en 1979 et de Leibstadt en 1984 . En 2008 , des exploitants de centrales nucl\u00e9aires avaient d\u00e9pos\u00e9 trois demandes d\u2019autorisation g\u00e9n\u00e9rale pour la construction de nouvelles centrales nucl\u00e9aires . Suite \u00e0 l\u2019accident nucl\u00e9aire survenu dans la centrale nucl\u00e9aire de Fukushima Daiichi ( au Japon ) , le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement , des transports , de l ' \u00e9nergie et de la communication ( DETEC ) d\u00e9cide en mars 2011 de suspendre toute proc\u00e9dure de demande d\u2019autorisation g\u00e9n\u00e9rale pour de nouvelles centrales nucl\u00e9aires . Ult\u00e9rieurement cette ann\u00e9e - l\u00e0 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et le Parlement posent la premi\u00e8re pierre de la nouvelle politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( Strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 ) en d\u00e9cidant de sortir progressivement du nucl\u00e9aire . Fin 2016 , les exploitants de centrales nucl\u00e9aires avaient retir\u00e9 ces trois demandes . En mai 2017 , le peuple accepte la loi sur l ' \u00e9nergie r\u00e9vis\u00e9e d\u00e9coulant du projet relatif au premier paquet de mesures de la Strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 . Depuis le 1er janvier 2018 , l ' octroi de nouvelles autorisations g\u00e9n\u00e9rales destin\u00e9es \u00e0 des centrales nucl\u00e9aires est donc interdit . La centrale nucl\u00e9aire de M\u00fchleberg a \u00e9t\u00e9 mise \u00e0 l\u2019arr\u00eat en d\u00e9cembre 2019 et est depuis en cours de d\u00e9mant\u00e8lement . Les autres centrales sont toujours en exploitation . La l\u00e9gislation suisse sur l\u2019\u00e9nergie nucl\u00e9aire ne pr\u00e9voit aucune limitation de la dur\u00e9e d\u2019exploitation . Elles peuvent \u00eatre exploit\u00e9es pour autant qu\u2019elles satisfassent aux exigences de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 . sentence1: DETEC ' s regulatory authority and extra - parliamentary committees Federal Communications Commission ComCom The Federal Communications Commission ( ComCom ) is the licensing and regulatory body for the telecommunications sector . ComCom is comprised of seven members who are all appointed by the Federal Council . The commission is independent from federal agencies and reaches its own decisions . Swiss Federal Electricity Commission ElCom ElCom is Switzerland ' s independent regulatory authority in the electricity sector . It is responsible for monitoring compliance with the Swiss Federal Electricity Act and the Swiss Federal Energy Act , taking all necessary related decisions and pronouncing rulings where required . ElCom monitors electricity prices and rules as a judicial authority on disputes relating to network access and payment of cost - covering feed - in of electricity produced from renewable energy . It also monitors electricity supply security and regulates issues relating to international electricity transmission and trading . Federal Postal Services Commission PostCom Federal Postal Services Commission ( PostCom ) is a technically independent body responsible for supervising the Swiss postal market . It sees to it that basic postal services are efficient , of good quality and affordable to all . Rail Transport Commission RailCom The Rail Transport Commission ( RailCom ) is responsible for handling disputes regarding access to the railway network and the calculation of fees for the use of infrastructure . In its supervisory capacity , RailCom monitors compliance with the principles of non - discrimination and transparency . RailCom was established as part of the 1999 railways reform , which mainly sought to introduce free access to the railway network . Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television ICA The Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television ( ICA ) handles complaints relating to radio and television programmes by the SRG and private broadcasters . The ICA seeks to determine possible breaches of the law in editorial broadcasts or unlawful refusal of the right to appear on a programme . However , the ombudsman service must be contacted to review the matter first , before a formal complaint can be filed with the ICA . Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board STSB The Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board ( STSB ) is the State authority of the Swiss Confederation which has a mandate to investigate accidents and dangerous incidents involving trains , aircraft , inland navigation ships , and seagoing vessels . The aim of this activity is to determine not only the direct causes of such events but also the more deep - seated reasons and other risks associated with them . This sole objective of this form of investigation is to acquire insights by means of which future accidents and hazardous situations can be prevented and which result in improved safety . However , the results of such a safety investigation are not intended to clarify questions of blame and liability . Links Federal State Calendar : Regulatory authority ( in French )
sentence2: Autorit\u00e9s de r\u00e9gulation et commissions extraparlementaires du DETEC Commission f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de la communication ComCom La commission f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de la communication ( ComCom ) est l ' autorit\u00e9 ind\u00e9pendante de r\u00e9gulation du march\u00e9 des t\u00e9l\u00e9communications et oc - troie les concessions . Compos\u00e9e de sept membres nomm\u00e9s par le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , la commission est ind\u00e9pendante des autorit\u00e9s administratives et prend ses d\u00e9cisions en toute ind\u00e9pendance . Commission f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 ElCom L ' ElCom est l ' autorit\u00e9 f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ind\u00e9pendante de r\u00e9gulation dans le domaine de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 . Elle surveille le respect de la loi sur l ' approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 et de la loi sur l ' \u00e9nergie , prenant les mesures et rendant les d\u00e9cisions n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 cet effet . Elle contr\u00f4le les prix de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 , statue sur les litiges concernant le libre acc\u00e8s au r\u00e9seau \u00e9lectrique et tranche en cas de divergences de vues quant \u00e0 la r\u00e9tribution \u00e0 prix co\u00fbtant du courant issu d ' \u00e9nergies renouvelables inject\u00e9 dans le r\u00e9seau . Elle v\u00e9rifie la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de l ' approvisionnement du pays en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 et r\u00e8gle les questions de transport et de commerce international d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 . Commission f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de la poste PostCom La Commission f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de la poste ( PostCom ) , ind\u00e9pendante sur le plan technique , a pour mission de surveiller le march\u00e9 postal suisse et de veiller \u00e0 ce que les prestations de service public soient efficaces , de bonne qualit\u00e9 et accessibles \u00e0 tous \u00e0 des prix abordables . Commission des chemins de fer RailCom La Commission des chemins de fer ( RailCom ) est charg\u00e9e de juger les litiges aff\u00e9rents \u00e0 l\u2019octroi de l\u2019acc\u00e8s au r\u00e9seau et au calcul de la redevance d\u2019utilisation de l\u2019infrastructure . Cr\u00e9\u00e9e \u00e0 la suite de la r\u00e9forme des chemins de fer lanc\u00e9e en 1999 , dont le point fort \u00e9tait l\u2019introduction du libre acc\u00e8s au r\u00e9seau , elle est charg\u00e9e d ' assurer la surveillance afin de faire respecter les principes de non - discrimination et de transparence . Autorit\u00e9 ind\u00e9pendante d ' examen des plaintes en mati\u00e8re de radio - t\u00e9l\u00e9vision AIEP L ' Autorit\u00e9 ind\u00e9pendante d\u2019examen des plaintes en mati\u00e8re de radio - t\u00e9l\u00e9vision ( AIEP ) \u00e9value les recours concernant le contenu d ' \u00e9missions de radio et de t\u00e9l\u00e9vision . Elle \u00e9tablit si des \u00e9missions \u00e0 caract\u00e8re r\u00e9dactionnel diffus\u00e9es ont enfreint le droit en vigueur et si l ' acc\u00e8s \u00e0 un programme a \u00e9t\u00e9 refus\u00e9 . Une personne ne peut d\u00e9poser une plainte \u00e0 l ' AIEP que pour autant qu\u2019elle ait particip\u00e9 \u00e0 une proc\u00e9dure devant l\u2019organe de m\u00e9diation comp\u00e9tent . Service suisse d ' enqu\u00eate de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 SESE Le Service suisse d ' enqu\u00eate de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 ( SESE ) est l ' autorit\u00e9 de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse charg\u00e9e de mener des enqu\u00eates sur les accidents et incidents survenant dans le domaine des chemins de fer , de l ' aviation civile , des bateaux de navigation int\u00e9rieure et des navires de mer . Les enqu\u00eates doivent non seulement permettre de d\u00e9terminer les causes directes de tels \u00e9v\u00e9nements mais \u00e9galement d ' identifier les causes profondes ainsi que les risques qui y sont directement li\u00e9s . Elles servent exclusivement \u00e0 acqu\u00e9rir des connaissances en vue de pr\u00e9venir des accidents futurs ainsi que des situations de danger et en vue d ' am\u00e9liorer la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 dans ce domaine . En revanche , leurs r\u00e9sultats ne doivent nullement servir \u00e0 d\u00e9terminer des fautes ou des responsabilit\u00e9s .

sentence1: Winners of the 2025 Watt d ' Or awards The winners of the 2025 Watt d ' Or awards have been chosen ! This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on 9 January 2025 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category SeasON : today\u2019s energy \u2013 tomorrow\u2019s warmth . A unique and innovative energy solution has been in operation in Frauenfeld ( TG ) since autumn 2024 : the SeasON sorption storage heat pump , developed by the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts ( HSLU ) and Matica AG from Kaltenbach in the canton of Thurgau . SeasON ' s catchy slogan , ' today ' s energy \u2013 tomorrow ' s warmth ' , sums up what it is all about : surplus renewable energy produced in the summer is stored for use in the winter by means of a thermochemical process . The process uses sodium hydroxide solution , which is concentrated using renewable energy or heat in summer by extracting water from it . The sodium hydroxide solution and the water can then be stored separately at room temperature without any losses until winter . When the sodium hydroxide is diluted again by means of evaporation and absorption of water , heat is generated , which can then be used for heating by the sorption storage heat pump with almost no additional electrical energy . The first pilot plant in Frauenfeld has shown how well this works . Two additional larger pilot plants in Switzerland and Germany will follow in the coming months , after which SeasOn should be able to position itself successfully on the market . \u201cRenewable energies\u201d category Agrivoltaics in Buchs where the sun provides a double harvest . Plants need sunlight to grow , and solar panels need sunlight to produce electricity . Thanks to the agrivoltaic system on the roofs of the new greenhouses at Lubera AG in Buchs ( SG ) , sunlight can be used for both at the same time . The system , built by the local energy supply company ewb , covers 10 , 700 square metres and generates around 750 , 000kWh of solar power for the ewb grid every year . The more than 6 , 600 photovoltaic panels with an installed capacity of 812kWp were developed by the company Insolight from Renens ( VS ) and Reech AG from Landquart in Graub\u00fcnden . The panels , which are seamlessly integrated into the greenhouse roofs , are transparent , so that 20 per cent of the sunlight can be used to produce electricity and 80 per cent is left for the plants in the greenhouse . This guarantees a double ' harvest ' . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category The e - power tunnel : Charging infrastructure for sustainable transport logistics . \ We think in generations \ is not just Galliker Transport\u2019s slogan , it has been the company ' s recipe for success for over a hundred years . The third - generation family business knows that it needs long - term visions and sustainable goals to ensure that each successive generation can continue to successfully sustain its strong brand . With its ' Green Logistics by Galliker ' concept , the family is committed to sustainable business practices and treating people , the environment and nature with respect . It has set itself the goal of becoming carbon neutral by 2050 , a vision that it is now actively putting into practice : around 10 per cent of its vehicle fleet is already equipped with alternative drive systems . The charging infrastructure it uses has also been improved . This has been achieved with an innovative underground e - power tunnel at the company ' s head office in Altishofen ( LU ) , which can charge 28 electric trucks with up to 200kW of power . Similar tunnels will soon be built at other Galliker sites . Galliker Transport AG carried out this project together with Fent AG from Seon ( AG ) , Thomas L\u00fcem Partner AG from Baar ( ZG ) and CKW AG from Lucerne . \u201cBuildings and spatial development\u201d category Micro - district networks : Sharing heat intelligently with neighbours . Today , it is possible to share electricity from a rooftop photovoltaic system with neighbours for collective self - consumption . However , the same principle makes sense for heating , because many home heating systems are oversized and therefore not used to full capacity . By sharing the heat from your own heating system with neighbours , you can save on maintenance and heating costs . How well this works has been shown by the energy company IWB ( Industrielle Werke Basel ) . Since autumn 2023 , three terraced houses in a residential area in Basel have been connected to a ground source heat pump and two gas heating systems to form a micro - district heating network . In the first winter , more than 90 per cent of their heating was provided by renewable energy from the heat pump at a cost 15 per cent lower than before . The micro - district heating network could be a solution for around 300 , 000 properties in Switzerland that are adjacent to at least one other house in need of a heating solution . Technically , the micro - district heating network is easy to realise . The idea , which originated in Basel , therefore has the potential to be used throughout Switzerland . Special Jury Award Network tariffs contribute to an efficient and secure electricity network . In Switzerland , more and more electricity is being produced locally and fed into the electricity distribution network , for example from photovoltaic systems on buildings , while ever more consumers are drawing electricity from the distribution network , such as for electric vehicles and heat pumps . This means that the distribution network is becoming increasingly overloaded . To ensure an efficient and reliable electricity supply for consumers , as well as distribution of the electricity generated , it is not only the expansion of the distribution networks that is needed , but also dynamic network tariffs . Their potential can be fully exploited thanks to the widespread use of smart meters . The electricity industry is actively exploring network tariffs and different approaches . Four projects will receive the 2025 Watt d ' Or in the Special Jury Award category : Genossenschaft Elektra , Jegenstorf ( BE ) , Groupe E ( FR ) , AEM ( TI ) and EKZ together with ETH Zurich ( ZH ) . sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2025 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2025 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e le 9 janvier 2025 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques SeasON : l\u2019\u00e9nergie d\u2019aujourd\u2019hui \u2013 la chaleur de demain ( Today\u2019s energy \u2013 tomorrow\u2019s warmth ) . Depuis l\u2019automne 2024 , une innovation technique unique en son genre est exploit\u00e9e \u00e0 Frauenfeld ( TG ) : la pompe \u00e0 chaleur \u00e0 r\u00e9servoir \u00e0 sorption SeasON , d\u00e9velopp\u00e9e par la Haute \u00e9cole sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9e de Lucerne HSLU et Matica AG ( Kaltenbach , TG ) . Le slogan accrocheur choisi \u00abtoday\u2019s energy \u2013 tomorrow\u2019s warmth\u00bb d\u00e9crit parfaitement de quoi il s\u2019agit . L\u2019\u00e9nergie renouvelable exc\u00e9dentaire est stock\u00e9e en \u00e9t\u00e9 gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 un proc\u00e9d\u00e9 thermochimique , afin d\u2019\u00eatre utilis\u00e9e en hiver . Pour ce faire , on recourt \u00e0 de la soude caustique ( hydroxyde de sodium ) . Cette derni\u00e8re est chauff\u00e9e en \u00e9t\u00e9 avec de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 ou de la chaleur renouvelable , l\u2019eau s\u2019\u00e9vapore et la soude se concentre . La soude caustique et l\u2019eau peuvent \u00eatre stock\u00e9es \u00e0 temp\u00e9rature ambiante jusqu\u2019\u00e0 l\u2019hiver , sans perte . En diluant la soude caustique \u00e0 nouveau par \u00e9vaporation et absorption d ' eau , de la chaleur se lib\u00e8re qui permet \u00e0 la pompe \u00e0 chaleur \u00e0 r\u00e9servoir \u00e0 sorption de chauffer presque sans \u00e9nergie \u00e9lectrique suppl\u00e9mentaire . La premi\u00e8re installation pilote de Frauenfeld montre que cela fonctionne bien . Deux autres installations pilotes de plus grande taille doivent voir le jour dans les prochains mois en Suisse et en Allemagne . SeasON pourra ensuite se positionner sur le march\u00e9 avec succ\u00e8s . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables Agri - photovolta\u00efsme ( agri - PV ) \u00e0 Buchs : le soleil offre une double r\u00e9colte . La lumi\u00e8re du soleil est essentielle pour faire pousser les plantes . Et les modules photovolta\u00efques sont n\u00e9cessaires pour produire de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 l\u2019installation agri - photovolta\u00efque qui a vu le jour sur les toits des nouvelles serres de Lubera AG \u00e0 Buchs , dans le canton de St - Gall , le soleil peut \u00eatre utilis\u00e9 \u00e0 ces deux fins . D\u2019une surface de 10 700 m2 , elle a \u00e9t\u00e9 mise en place par ewb , l\u2019entreprise municipale d\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie , et produit pr\u00e8s de 750 000 kWh d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 solaire par an pour le r\u00e9seau d\u2019ewb . Elle compte plus de 6600 modules PV , d\u2019une puissance install\u00e9e de 812 kWc , d\u00e9velopp\u00e9s par les soci\u00e9t\u00e9s Insolight de Renens , dans le canton de Vaud , et Reech de Landquart , aux Grisons . Ils sont int\u00e9gr\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re optimale au toit et translucides : la lumi\u00e8re solaire peut \u00eatre utilis\u00e9e pour produire de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 \u00e0 hauteur de 20 % , tandis que 80 % servent pour les cultures dans les serres . Une double \u00ab r\u00e9colte \u00bb est donc garantie . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie Tunnel E - Power : infrastructure de recharge pour une logistique de transport durable . \u00abNous pensons aux g\u00e9n\u00e9rations futures\u00bb . Chez Galliker Transport AG , il ne s\u2019agit pas d\u2019une simple maxime , mais de la recette qui fait le succ\u00e8s de l\u2019entreprise depuis plus de 100 ans . Dirig\u00e9e par la troisi\u00e8me g\u00e9n\u00e9ration , l\u2019entreprise familiale sait que des visions \u00e0 long terme et des objectifs durables sont indispensables pour pouvoir remettre entre les mains de la prochaine g\u00e9n\u00e9ration une marque bien \u00e9tablie dont elle poursuivra le d\u00e9veloppement . Dans sa strat\u00e9gie \u00abGreen Logistics Galliker\u00bb , l\u2019entreprise familiale s\u2019engage \u00e0 pratiquer une action durable et \u00e0 avoir une attitude respectueuse envers l\u2019homme , la nature et l\u2019environnement . Son objectif est d\u2019\u00eatre neutre en CO2 d\u2019ici 2050 . Cette vision est mise en \u0153uvre de mani\u00e8re cons\u00e9quente . Pr\u00e8s de 10 % de la flotte de v\u00e9hicules est d\u00e9j\u00e0 constitu\u00e9e de v\u00e9hicules \u00e0 propulsion alternative . Il faut maintenant aussi moderniser l\u2019infrastructure de recharge . C\u2019est chose faite avec le tunnel E - Power . Cette installation souterraine novatrice a vu le jour au si\u00e8ge principal de l\u2019entreprise , \u00e0 Altishofen ( LU ) . Elle permet de charger 28 camions \u00e9lectriques , avec une puissance allant jusqu\u2019\u00e0 200 kW . Des tunnels similaires devraient bient\u00f4t devenir r\u00e9alit\u00e9 sur les autres sites de Galliker . Outre Galliker Transport AG , le Watt d\u2019Or 2025 distingue \u00e9galement les entreprises partenaires ayant collabor\u00e9 \u00e0 ce projet : Fent AG de Seon ( AG ) , Thomas L\u00fcem Partner AG de Baar ( ZG ) et CKW AG de Lucerne . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace Nanor\u00e9seau : partager intelligemment la chaleur avec ses voisins . Le regroupement dans le cadre de la consommation propre permet de partager avec ses voisins l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 provenant d\u2019une installation photovolta\u00efque sur le toit . Appliquer le m\u00eame principe \u00e0 la chaleur semble judicieux : en effet , de nombreux chauffages dans les b\u00e2timents d\u2019habitation sont surdimensionn\u00e9s et par cons\u00e9quent sous - exploit\u00e9s . En partageant la chaleur de son chauffage avec ses voisins , on \u00e9conomise sur les frais d\u2019entretien et de chauffage . L\u2019entreprise \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique IWB ( Industrielle Werke Basel ) a d\u00e9montr\u00e9 dans un quartier de B\u00e2le que ce mod\u00e8le fonctionne tr\u00e8s bien . Depuis l\u2019automne 2023 , trois maisons mitoyennes \u00e9quip\u00e9es , pour l\u2019une , d\u2019une pompe \u00e0 chaleur \u00e0 sonde g\u00e9othermique et , pour les deux autres , de chauffages au gaz , sont regroup\u00e9es pour former un nanor\u00e9seau ( minir\u00e9seau de chaleur ) . Durant le premier hiver , elles ont \u00e9t\u00e9 chauff\u00e9es \u00e0 plus de 90 % avec de la chaleur renouvelable provenant de la pompe \u00e0 chaleur , les co\u00fbts \u00e9tant 15 % plus bas qu\u2019auparavant . Un nanor\u00e9seau peut \u00eatre une solution pour les quelque 300 000 b\u00e2timents en Suisse situ\u00e9s \u00e0 proximit\u00e9 imm\u00e9diate d\u2019au moins une autre maison et ayant besoin d\u2019un concept de chauffage . Un nanor\u00e9seau est facile \u00e0 mettre en \u0153uvre sur le plan technique . L\u2019id\u00e9e n\u00e9e \u00e0 B\u00e2le pourrait devenir un mod\u00e8le pour toute la Suisse . Prix sp\u00e9cial du jury Les tarifs de r\u00e9seau contribuent \u00e0 un r\u00e9seau d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 efficace et s\u00fbr . En Suisse , la part d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 produite de mani\u00e8re d\u00e9centralis\u00e9e et inject\u00e9e dans le r\u00e9seau de distribution , par exemple depuis des installations PV sur les b\u00e2timents , est en augmentation . Par ailleurs , le nombre de consommateurs ( voitures \u00e9lectriques , pompes \u00e0 chaleurs , etc . ) soutirant de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 depuis le r\u00e9seau de distribution est lui aussi en hausse . Le r\u00e9seau de distribution est donc de plus en plus sollicit\u00e9 . Pour qu\u2019\u00e0 l\u2019avenir , les consommateurs continuent d\u2019\u00eatre approvisionn\u00e9s en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 de mani\u00e8re efficace et fiable et que l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 produite puisse \u00eatre transport\u00e9e , il ne faut pas seulement d\u00e9velopper les r\u00e9seaux de distribution . Des tarifs de r\u00e9seau dynamiques sont aussi susceptibles de jouer un r\u00f4le crucial . Leur potentiel peut \u00eatre exploit\u00e9 gr\u00e2ce aux \u00abcompteurs intelligents\u00bb , qui sont aujourd\u2019hui largement r\u00e9pandus . La branche se penche activement sur la question et examine plusieurs approches . Quatre projets sont r\u00e9compens\u00e9s par le Watt d\u2019Or 2025 dans la cat\u00e9gorie \u00abPrix sp\u00e9cial du jury\u00bb : la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 coop\u00e9rative Elektra de Jegenstorf ( BE ) ; Groupe E ( FR ) , AEM ( TI ) et EKZ en collaboration avec l\u2019\u00c9cole polytechnique f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de Zurich ( EPFZ ; ZH ) . sentence1: Risk coverage for thermal networks and long - term storage Aktuell The Climate and Innovation Act was adopted by popular vote on June 18th 2023 . It entered into force on January 1st 2025 , together with its application ordinance . The law provides for the introduction of a hedge for risks associated with investments in public infrastructure projects required to achieve the net - zero goal ( art . 7 Climate and Innovation Act ) . This includes thermal networks and long - term thermal storage , which can be covered by part of the financial resources made available for the promotion of new technologies and processes ( art . 6 Climate and Innovation Act ) . Eligible risks are those whose occurrence is not foreseeable and which are beyond the control of the operator . In the case of thermal networks , the restriction or loss of heat production and the loss of a significant portion of heat sales are considered such risks . For long - term thermal storage it is the reduction in storage efficiency of more than 15 % and , in the case of pit thermal energy storage , the unforeseeable restriction of surface use ( so - called dual use ) . The cover is for up to CHF 5 million and covers a maximum of half of the sustained financial loss . itinero @ bfe . admin . ch The application for a risk coverage can be submitted to BFE starting from January 1st 2025 ( ) . sentence2: Couverture des risques pour les r\u00e9seaux thermiques et le stockage \u00e0 long terme Actualit\u00e9s La loi sur le climat et l ' innovation a \u00e9t\u00e9 adopt\u00e9e lors de la votation populaire du 18 juin 2023 . Elle est entr\u00e9e en vigueur , avec l ' ordonnance correspondante , le 1er janvier 2025 . La loi pr\u00e9voit l ' introduction de couvertures pour les risques li\u00e9s aux investissements dans les ouvrages d ' infrastructure publics n\u00e9cessaires pour atteindre l ' objectif z\u00e9ro net ( art . 7 LCl ) . On entend par l\u00e0 les r\u00e9seaux thermiques et les accumulateurs thermiques \u00e0 long terme , qui sont couverts par une partie des moyens financiers mis \u00e0 disposition pour la promotion de technologies et de processus nouveaux ( art . 6 LCl ) . Les risques couverts sont ceux dont la survenance n ' est pas pr\u00e9visible et qui ne sont pas sous le contr\u00f4le des exploitants . Pour les r\u00e9seaux thermiques , il s ' agit de la limitation ou de la suppression de la production de chaleur ainsi que de la suppression d ' une partie importante des ventes de chaleur . Pour les accumulateurs thermiques de longue dur\u00e9e , il s ' agit de la diminution de l ' efficacit\u00e9 de l ' accumulateur de plus de 15 % ainsi que de la limitation impr\u00e9visible de l ' utilisation de la surface ( dite double utilisation ) pour les syst\u00e8mes de stockage en fosse . La couverture s ' \u00e9l\u00e8ve jusqu ' \u00e0 5 millions de francs et couvre au maximum la moiti\u00e9 des dommages financiers subis . itinero @ bfe . admin . ch La demande de couverture peut \u00eatre d\u00e9pos\u00e9e aupr\u00e8s de l ' OFEN \u00e0 partir du 1er janvier 2025 ( ) . sentence1: \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb Switzerland autonomously introduced , and incorporated into national law through the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade , the \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb , which was developed by the European Court of Justice . Negative List ( PDF , 193 kB , 01 . 01 . 2025 ) The \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb stipulates that a product which complies with the technical regulations of the EU , a member state of the EU or that of the EEA , and is legally placed on the market in one of these member states , may in principle be placed on the Swiss market without any further controls ( art . 16a of the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade ) . Exceptions to the principle are only possible when overriding public interests are at stake . An indicative ( in German ) includes all products excluded from the \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb . Swiss manufacturers , who produce exclusively for the Swiss market , can also place products manufactured according to the regulations of EU or EU / EEA member state on the Swiss market ( measures aimed at avoiding discrimination of domestic manufacturers ) . foodstuffs The application of the \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb for is subject to specific provisions ( authorisation process ) . The Federal Council may approve , in justified cases , exceptions to the principle when overriding public interests are at stake , such as concerns over public health , animal and plant health or life . In 2013 , SECO published a report on the effects of the \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb in Switzerland . The report highlights that , following the introduction of the \u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb , a process was set in motion to reduce technical barriers to trade without having a negative effect on the overall protection level . The report also shows that the\u00abCassis de Dijon principle\u00bb helped avoid additional and unfounded barriers to trade , and impeded the creation of new Swiss regulation which diverged from that of the EU . Specialist staff Last modification 23 . 01 . 2025
sentence2: \u00abPrincipe Cassis de Dijon\u00bb principe Cassis de Dijon LETC La Suisse applique de mani\u00e8re autonome le principe Cassis de Dijon , d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 par la Cour de justice des Communaut\u00e9s europ\u00e9ennes ( CJCE ) , qu\u2019elle a introduit dans la . liste n\u00e9gative ( PDF , 218 kB , 01 . 01 . 2025 ) Conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 ce principe , les produits qui satisfont aux prescriptions techniques de l\u2019UE ou d\u2019un Etat membre de l\u2019UE ou de l\u2019EEE et qui y circulent l\u00e9galement peuvent \u00eatre commercialis\u00e9s librement en Suisse sans contr\u00f4le pr\u00e9alable ( art . 16a LETC ) . Seules les exceptions destin\u00e9es \u00e0 prot\u00e9ger des int\u00e9r\u00eats publics pr\u00e9pond\u00e9rants sont admises . Les produits exclus du domaine d\u2019application du \u00abprincipe Cassis de Dijon\u00bb sont inscrits sur une . sentence1: Bioenergy The \u201cBioenergy\u201d research programme supports innovative and relevant themes for Switzerland in the production of energy from biomass . The programme coordinates application - oriented research at the national level , exploits synergies and secures international networking . Central questions for the future concern which biomass proportions are used with which technologies and for which products in order to make a substantial contribution to the Swiss energy system while achieving a high level of efficiency . The system concept is becoming increasingly relevant , for example in relation to energy - storage issues , interaction with other energy technologies and bioeconomy concepts . In this context the increasingly cascading use of biomass and the circular economy is of central importance . In addition to the integration of bioenergy facilities in the overall energy system , ongoing technical innovation and optimisation of already existing technologies are important for making more efficient transformation processes available for the market . Research priorities for 2021 to 2024 Biomass as substrate Procurement of biomass , logistics ( mobilisation , innovative logistics ) ; new biomass substrate ; biogenic waste ( material and energy recycling ) . Biomass for electricity and heat supply and as fuel Production of process heat ; innovative concepts for combining cogeneration plants with biogenic energy sources ; optimal design configurations of district heat networks ; small - scale biogas production for decentralised - use concepts ; biofuels as \u201cdrop - in\u201d fuels . Biomass in the bioeconomy Integration of materials recycling to generate material and energy added value ( e . g . use of residual materials ) ; energy aspects in the production of bio - based platform chemicals ( efficiency , energy optimisation , integration , life - cycle assessment , etc . ) ; higher added value of bioenergy facilities ( new concepts , products ) . L\u2019approche syst\u00e9mique gagne en importance , par exemple par rapport au stockage de l\u2019\u00e9nergie , aux interactions avec d\u2019autres technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques ou \u00e0 la bio\u00e9conomie . sentence1: The Federal Department of Justice and Police ( FDJP ) The Federal Department of Justice and Police ( FDJP ) deals with issues such as asylum , migration and internal security . The department has been headed by Beat Jans since January 2024 . Federal Councillor Beat Jans Beat Jans was born in 1964 and grew up in Riehen in the canton of Basel - Stadt . He successfully completed his apprenticeship as a farmer in the canton of Basel - Landschaft . Later , he earned a degree as an agricultural engineer from the Technical Centre for Tropical Agriculture ( TTL ) , and an environmental science degree from Swiss Federal Institute of Technology ETH Zurich . He worked as a consultant in the environmental and communication fields , partly on a freelance basis . In addition , he has worked in development cooperation , as a lecturer at the University of Basel and as an executive board member of nature conservation organisation Pro Natura . Beat Jans is married and has two daughters . Beat Jans was president of the Basel - Stadt section of the Social Democratic Party ( SP ) from 2000 to 2005 , and a member of the cantonal parliament from 2001 to 2011 . He served on the the National Council from 2010 to 2020 and as vice president of SP Switzerland from 2015 to 2020 . He was the president of the Basel - Stadt cantonal council from 2021 until he was elected to serve on the Federal Council in late 2023 . Election to the Federal Council The United Federal Assembly elected Beat Jans to the Federal Council on 13 December 2023 . He took over as head of the Federal Department of Justice and Police ( FDJP ) in January 2024 . The Federal Department of Justice and Police ( FDJP ) The FDJP deals with crime , asylum issues , internal security and the coexistence of people of different nationalities . Civil status and civil rights issues also fall under the FDJP\u2019s remit , as does the oversight of gambling and international judicial and police cooperation . sentence2: Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de justice et police ( DFJP ) Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de justice et police ( DFJP ) s ' occupe de th\u00e8mes tels que les droits civiques , la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 int\u00e9rieure , l ' asile ou la migration . Il est dirig\u00e9 par Beat Jans depuis janvier 2024 . Le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Beat Jans Beat Jans est n\u00e9 en 1964 . Il a grandi \u00e0 Riehen , dans le canton de B\u00e2le - Ville . Apr\u00e8s un apprentissage d\u2019agriculteur dans le canton de B\u00e2le - Campagne , il a obtenu un dipl\u00f4me d\u2019agrotechnicien au Technicum d\u2019agriculture tropicale de B\u00e2le , suivi quelques ann\u00e9es plus tard par un dipl\u00f4me de scientifique de l\u2019environnement \u00e0 l\u2019\u00c9cole polytechnique f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de Zurich . Il a travaill\u00e9 comme conseiller dans les domaines de l\u2019environnement et de la communication , avant de se mettre partiellement \u00e0 son compte . Il a occup\u00e9 au surplus des postes dans la collaboration au d\u00e9veloppement et \u00e0 la direction de Pro Natura , ainsi qu ' enseign\u00e9 \u00e0 l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de B\u00e2le . Il est mari\u00e9 et p\u00e8re de deux enfants . Beat Jans a pr\u00e9sid\u00e9 le Parti socialiste du canton de B\u00e2le - Ville de 2000 \u00e0 2005 et occup\u00e9 l\u2019un des postes de vice - pr\u00e9sident du Parti socialiste suisse de 2015 \u00e0 2020 . Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 d\u00e9put\u00e9 au Grand Conseil du canton de B\u00e2le - Ville de 2001 \u00e0 2011 et a si\u00e9g\u00e9 au Conseil national de 2010 \u00e0 2020 . Il a ensuite \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9lu au Conseil d\u2019\u00c9tat du canton de B\u00e2le - Ville , qu\u2019il a pr\u00e9sid\u00e9 de 2021 \u00e0 2023 . \u00c9lection au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Le 13 d\u00e9cembre 2023 , l ' Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale a \u00e9lu le socialiste Beat Jans au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il dirige le DFJP depuis janvier 2024 . Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de justice et police ( DFJP ) Le DFJP traite de th\u00e8mes relevant de la politique sociale tels que la cohabitation de personnes de nationalit\u00e9 diff\u00e9rente , les questions relatives \u00e0 l ' asile , la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 int\u00e9rieure ou la lutte contre la criminalit\u00e9 . L ' \u00e9tat civil ou les questions de droit de cit\u00e9 font \u00e9galement partie de la palette des t\u00e2ches du DFJP , tout comme la surveillance des jeux de hasard ou l ' \u00e9laboration de bases et de moyens destin\u00e9s \u00e0 la collaboration internationale en mati\u00e8re de justice et de police . Le DFJP en chiffres Postes \u00e0 plein temps ( 2022 ) : 2794 En 2022 , les charges du DFJP ont atteint un montant de 2 , 99 milliards de francs . Derni\u00e8re modification 07 . 11 . 2024

sentence1: Outsourcing translations Does a translation need to be outsourced ? Article 11 of the Language Services Ordinance and section 4 of the Federal Chancellery instructions on the provision of language services regulate the use of external translators . Texts can be outsourced for translation in urgent cases or when the internal services have too much work and when all other internal options have been exhausted . How do I outsource a translation ? If you need to send a text out for translation , you should first contact the section in charge of language services . If your department\u2019s head translator cannot put you in touch with a translator , you can contact the Federal Chancellery , which maintains a list of qualified external translators . Further information Links Ordinance on the Federal Administration Language Services Federal Chancellery instructions on the provision of language services ( in German , French and Italian )

sentence1: Swissnex Swissnex is the global network connecting Switzerland and the world in education , research and innovation . Our mission is to support the outreach and active engagement of our partners in the international exchange of knowledge , ideas and talent . The six main Swissnex locations are established in the world\u2019s most innovative regions . Together with around twenty Science Offices and Counselors based in Swiss Embassies , they contribute to strengthen Switzerland\u2019s profile as a world - leading innovation hotspot . sentence1: The Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) The Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) represents Switzerland abroad . It has been headed by Ignazio Cassis since November 2017 . Federal Councillor Ignazio Cassis Ignazio Cassis was born on 13 April 1961 . In 1987 he earned a degree in medicine from the University of Zurich . In 1996 he obtained a post - graduate diploma in public health from the University of Geneva . In 1998 he completed specialist training in general medicine and in prevention and public health . He practised medicine between 1988 and 1996 . Between 1996 and 2008 he served as the Canton of Ticino\u2019s Chief Health Officer . Between 2008 and 2012 he was vice president of the Swiss Medical Association . He has lectured at various universities in Switzerland . He was president of CURAVIVA Switzerland ( Association of Swiss Care Homes and Social Institutions ) and of Curafutura , the association of innovative health insurers . Ignazio Cassis was elected to the National Council as a member of the FDP for the canton of Ticino in 2007 . From 2015 until his election to the Federal Council he was president of the FDP - Liberal parliamentary group . He was also chair of the National Council Social Security and Health Committee from 2015 . Ignazio Cassis is married . Election to the Federal Council On 20 September 2017 the Federal Assembly elected Ignazio Cassis to the Federal Council . Since 1 November 2017 he heads the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs . In 2022 he was President of the Swiss Confederation . The Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) The FDFA protects Switzerland\u2019s interests abroad and implements the Federal Council\u2019s foreign policy . This involves fostering and expanding relations with neighbouring states and the EU . The FDFA also wants to improve its services for Swiss living abroad by modernising its technology . FDFA facts and figures Staff ( full - time positions / 2022 ) : 5 , 469 Expenses 2022 : CHF 3 . 29 billion Last modification 29 . 12 . 2023
sentence2: Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des affaires \u00e9trang\u00e8res ( DFAE ) Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des affaires \u00e9trang\u00e8res ( DFAE ) repr\u00e9sente la Suisse \u00e0 l ' \u00e9tranger . Il est dirig\u00e9 depuis novembre 2017 par Ignazio Cassis . Le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Ignazio Cassis Ignazio Cassis est n\u00e9 le 13 avril 1961 . Il a obtenu un dipl\u00f4me de m\u00e9decine humaine de l ' Universit\u00e9 de Zurich ( 1987 ) , ainsi que de sant\u00e9 publique de l\u2019universit\u00e9 de Gen\u00e8ve ( 1996 ) . En 1998 , il est devenu sp\u00e9cialiste FMH en m\u00e9decine interne et en pr\u00e9vention et sant\u00e9 publique . Il a pratiqu\u00e9 son m\u00e9tier de m\u00e9decin de 1988 \u00e0 1996 . Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 m\u00e9decin cantonal du canton du Tessin de 1996 \u00e0 2008 et vice - pr\u00e9sident de la F\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse des m\u00e9decins ( FMH ) de 2008 \u00e0 2012 . Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 charg\u00e9 de cours dans plusieurs universit\u00e9s en Suisse . Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e0 la t\u00eate des associations CURAVIVA Suisse ( Homes et Institutions Sociales Suisses ) et curafutura , Les assureurs - maladie innovants . Ignazio Cassis est entr\u00e9 au Conseil national en 2007 comme repr\u00e9sentant tessinois du parti lib\u00e9ral - radical . De 2015 jusqu ' \u00e0 son \u00e9lection au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , il a \u00e9t\u00e9 pr\u00e9sident du groupe PLR aux Chambres f\u00e9d\u00e9rales et pr\u00e9sident de la commission de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 sociale et de la sant\u00e9 publique du Conseil national . Ignazio Cassis est mari\u00e9 . \u00c9lection au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Le 20 septembre 2017 , l ' Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale a \u00e9lu le lib\u00e9ral - radical Ignazio Cassis au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Depuis le 1er novembre 2017 , il dirige le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des affaires \u00e9trang\u00e8res ( DFAE ) . En 2022 , il a \u00e9t\u00e9 pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des affaires \u00e9trang\u00e8res ( DFAE ) Le DFAE d\u00e9fend les int\u00e9r\u00eats de la Suisse \u00e0 l ' \u00e9tranger et met en \u0153uvre la strat\u00e9gie du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral en mati\u00e8re de politique ext\u00e9rieure . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral entend tout sp\u00e9cialement entretenir et d\u00e9velopper les relations avec les \u00c9tats voisins et avec l ' UE . \u00c0 l ' aide de technologies modernes , le DFAE veut en outre tenir \u00e0 jour et am\u00e9liorer ses prestations en faveur des Suisses de l ' \u00e9tranger . Le DFAE en chiffres Postes \u00e0 plein temps ( 2022 ) : 5 ' 469 En 2022 , les charges du DFAE ont atteint un montant de 3 , 29 milliards de francs . Derni\u00e8re modification 28 . 12 . 2023

sentence1: Measures for increasing energy efficiency Building Programme In Switzerland more than 40 % of energy consumption and about a third of climate - damaging CO2 emissions are attributable to the building industry . Through the Building Programme the Federal Government and the cantons hope to reduce energy consumption considerably in the Swiss building industry and also lower CO2 emissions . This is why they subsidise the cost of the energy - saving renovation of buildings . The programme is partially financed by revenues from the CO2 levy on fuels . With the Energy Strategy more money is available from the CO2 levy for the Building Programme . Tax incentives for building renovation Investments carried out in buildings to improve energy efficiency are already tax - deductible today . With the implementation of new Energy Act , it is now also possible to deduct the costs of demolition to make way for a new building . Together with the costs of energy - related improvements , demolition costs can be deducted also in the next two tax periods if it is not possible to fully offset the expenditure in the year in which it was carried out . The aim here is to encourage total renovation instead of partial renovation , which until now has been more attractive in fiscal terms . Total renovation is more effective from the point of view of energy efficiency . Emissions specifications for motorised vehicles Motorised traffic accounts for more than a third of all energy consumption and CO2 emissions in Switzerland . Under the Energy Strategy 2050 , current emissions specifications will be tightened . As a consequence , the accepted limit for CO2 / km emissions for all new passenger vehicles on the road will be reduced to an average of 95g CO2 / km by the end of 2020 . New specifications will also be extended to delivery vehicles and light articulated trucks , which will be limited to an average of 147g CO2 / km by the end of 2020 . Both measures have been taken in accordance with EU law . Competitive tenders Programmes and projects which contribute towards more economical energy consumption in industry , the services sector and households are supported by competitive tenders . The promotional subsidies are awarded by auction . In this way projects and programmes with the best cost - benefit ratio get a chance to participate . The financing is covered by the grid surcharge that electricity consumers pay to promote renewable energies and energy efficiency . These promotional subsidies for competitive tenders are available until the year 2030 at the latest . sentence2: Mesures visant \u00e0 accro\u00eetre l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique Programme B\u00e2timents Plus de 40 % de la consommation d ' \u00e9nergie et de pr\u00e8s d ' un tiers des \u00e9missions de CO2 n\u00e9fastes pour le climat sont imputables au secteur du b\u00e2timent en Suisse . Avec le programme B\u00e2timents , la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et les cantons veulent nettement r\u00e9duire la consommation d ' \u00e9nergie et les \u00e9missions de CO2 du parc immobilier suisse en contribuant financi\u00e8rement \u00e0 la r\u00e9novation \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique des b\u00e2timents . Le programme est financ\u00e9 en partie par les recettes de la taxe sur le CO2 pr\u00e9lev\u00e9e sur les combustibles . La Strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 permet d ' allouer plus de moyens provenant de la taxe sur le CO2 au programme B\u00e2timents , ce qui le renforce . Incitations fiscales pour les r\u00e9novations \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques des b\u00e2timents Les investissements effectu\u00e9s dans des r\u00e9novations \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques de b\u00e2timents peuvent d\u00e9j\u00e0 \u00eatre d\u00e9duits de l ' imp\u00f4t sur le revenu . Avec la nouvelle loi sur l ' \u00e9nergie , les frais de d\u00e9molition li\u00e9s aux nouvelles constructions de remplacement sont d\u00e9sormais d\u00e9ductibles . Ces frais ainsi que les co\u00fbts d ' investissement \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques sont dor\u00e9navant aussi d\u00e9ductibles pendant les deux p\u00e9riodes fiscales suivantes dans la mesure o\u00f9 ces d\u00e9penses ne peuvent pas \u00eatre enti\u00e8rement prises en compte fiscalement l ' ann\u00e9e o\u00f9 elles ont \u00e9t\u00e9 effectu\u00e9es . On devrait ainsi voir augmenter le nombre de r\u00e9novations compl\u00e8tes , plus judicieuses sur le plan \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et d\u00e9sormais plus int\u00e9ressantes fiscalement que les r\u00e9novations partielles . Prescriptions sur les \u00e9missions de CO2 des v\u00e9hicules Les transports sont responsables de plus d ' un tiers de la consommation totale d ' \u00e9nergie et des \u00e9missions de CO2 en Suisse . Les prescriptions actuelles sur les \u00e9missions de CO2 sont renforc\u00e9es dans le cadre de la Strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 . Le niveau moyen des \u00e9missions des voitures de tourisme immatricul\u00e9es pour la premi\u00e8re fois doit \u00eatre r\u00e9duit \u00e0 seulement 95 g CO2 / km d ' ici \u00e0 fin 2020 . Les prescriptions sont en outre \u00e9tendues aux voitures de livraison et aux tracteurs \u00e0 sellette l\u00e9gers dont les \u00e9missions moyennes ne doivent pas d\u00e9passer 147 g CO2 / km d ' ici \u00e0 fin 2020 . Ces deux mesures sont conformes au droit europ\u00e9en . Appels d ' offres publics La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration utilise les appels d ' offres publics pour encourager des programmes et des projets contribuant \u00e0 r\u00e9duire la consommation d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 dans l ' industrie , les services et les m\u00e9nages . Les fonds affect\u00e9s \u00e0 cette t\u00e2che sont attribu\u00e9s sur la base d ' une proc\u00e9dure d ' adjudication au plus offrant , les projets et les programmes pr\u00e9sentant les meilleurs rapports co\u00fbts - utilit\u00e9 remportant l ' adjudication . Le financement est assur\u00e9 par le suppl\u00e9ment sur les co\u00fbts de transport acquitt\u00e9 par les consommateurs d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 afin d ' encourager les \u00e9nergies renouvelables et l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique . Les aides financi\u00e8res accord\u00e9es dans le cadre des appels d ' offres seront vers\u00e9es jusqu ' en 2030 au plus tard . sentence1: Data platform for the electricity sector The data platform ( data hub ) in the electricity sector serves as a centre for energy sector data . It is regulated by the Electricity Supply Act and the Electricity Supply Ordinance and is intended to ensure an efficient and secure exchange between electricity supply companies , balance groups , the national grid company and end consumers . The latter thus receive standardised digital data access , enabling them to easily provide their data to independent energy service providers and thus benefit from new digital services . The structure , tasks and functionalities of the data platform are defined by law and described in more detail in the industry guidelines . The platform is an important step for the digital innovation in the swiss energy sector . For information on applying for the national data platform , please see the press release ( link ) and the documents linked below . M\u00e4rz 2008 ( StromVV ) und revidierte Energieverordnung Specialist staff Last modification 03 . 03 . 2025
sentence2: Plateforme de donn\u00e9es pour le secteur de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 La plateforme de donn\u00e9es ( Datahub ) dans le secteur de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 sert d\u2019infrastructure nationale pour les donn\u00e9es \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques suisses . Son objectif est de garantir un \u00e9change performant et s\u00fbr entre les acteurs du syst\u00e8me \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique en r\u00e9unissant les entreprises d ' approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 , les groupes - bilan , la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 nationale du r\u00e9seau de transport et les consommateurs finaux au sein d\u2019une infrastructure commune . La structure , les devoirs et les fonctionnalit\u00e9s de la plateforme de donn\u00e9es sont r\u00e9gis par la loi sur l ' approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 , LApEl et son ordonnance , OApEI et pr\u00e9cis\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re d\u00e9taill\u00e9e dans les directives de la branche . Elle permettra aux consommateurs suisses de b\u00e9n\u00e9ficier d ' un acc\u00e8s uniformis\u00e9 \u00e0 leurs donn\u00e9es \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques . Ils pourront ainsi g\u00e9rer de mani\u00e8re simple et s\u00e9curis\u00e9e l\u2019acc\u00e8s \u00e0 leurs donn\u00e9es et les partager avec des fournisseurs de services tiers ind\u00e9pendants afin de b\u00e9n\u00e9ficier de nouveaux services num\u00e9riques innovants . La plateforme est une \u00e9tape importante pour l ' innovation num\u00e9rique dans le secteur de l ' \u00e9nergie . Vous trouverez plus d\u2019informations sur la demande d\u2019approbation pour la constitution de la plateforme de donn\u00e9es dans le communiqu\u00e9 de presse ( lien ) et les documents mis \u00e0 disposition ci - dessous . sentence1: Requirements for commercial dishwashers The Federal Council has decided on a declaration obligation for commercial dishwashers and thus improves transparency for the trade . As of 1 January 2024 , the energy and water consumption as well as the cleaning performance must be stated in the technical documentation and on a freely accessible website in accordance with the European standard EN IEC 63136 : 2019 . There is no energy label for commercial dishwashers . Switzerland is taking a pioneering role here , as there are currently no legal requirements for commercial dishwashers in the EU . Should the European Commission adopt requirements , then Switzerland will strive for harmonisation . sentence2: Exigences relatives aux lave - vaisselle professionnels Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a d\u00e9cid\u00e9 de rendre obligatoire une d\u00e9claration pour les lave - vaisselle professionnels . Cette d\u00e9marche devrait permettre aux membres de la branche de la restauration de choisir plus facilement des appareils . \u00c0 compter du 1er janvier 2024 , des documents techniques et un site Internet librement accessible devront fournir des indications relatives \u00e0 la consommation d\u2019\u00e9nergie et d\u2019eau , ainsi qu\u2019\u00e0 l\u2019aptitude \u00e0 la fonction de lavage des appareils , conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 la norme europ\u00e9enne EN IEC 63136 : 2019 . Les lave - vaisselle professionnels ne disposent pas d\u2019une \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie . sentence1: Vacuum cleaner In Switzerland , for vacuum cleaners the same efficiency requirements apply as those in effect in the EU . The maximum permissible power of vacuum cleaners is 900 watts and their annual electricity consumption with average use may not exceed 43 kilowatt hours ( kWh ) . The provisional energy label for vacuum cleaners is no longer valid . 18 . 1 . 2019 : The General Court of the European Union has annulled the Delegated Regulation ( EU ) 665 / 2013 on the energy labelling on vacuum cleaners . The provisions of the Swiss Energy Efficiency Regulation ( EnEV ) , Annex 1 . 8 , Section 4 are no longer legally binding . Manufacturers and distributors are therefore allowed to place their vacuum cleaners on the market and sell them without an energy label . However , existing energy labels do not have to be removed . sentence2: Aspirateurs La Suisse et l\u2019Union europ\u00e9enne disposent des m\u00eames exigences en mati\u00e8re d\u2019efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique pour ce qui est des aspirateurs . La puissance de ces appareils ne doit pas exc\u00e9der 900 watts et leur consommation moyenne ne doit pas \u00eatre sup\u00e9rieure \u00e0 43 kWh par an . L\u2019\u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie pour les aspirateurs , appliqu\u00e9e durant une courte p\u00e9riode , n\u2019est plus valable . 18 . 01 . 2019 : Le Tribunal de l ' Union europ\u00e9enne a invalid\u00e9 le r\u00e8glement europ\u00e9en n\u00b0 665 / 2013 . Les dispositions de l\u2019ordonnance sur les exigences relatives \u00e0 l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( OEEE ) , annexe 1 . 8 , section 4 , ne sont plus juridiquement contraignantes . Les fabricants et les revendeurs peuvent donc mettre leurs aspirateurs sur le march\u00e9 ou les vendre sans \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie . Toutefois , il n ' est pas n\u00e9cessaire d\u2019\u00f4ter les \u00e9tiquettes - \u00e9nergie existantes . sentence1: Role of the President of the Swiss Confederation Unlike in other countries , in Switzerland no one person is ever head of state . The president of the Confederation is ' primus inter pares ' \u2013 first among equals \u2013 for one year , but with the office there still comes a whole series of traditional duties and tasks . The President of the Swiss Confederation is elected for one year of office by the United Federal Assembly . Even though the title suggests otherwise , the president of the Swiss Confederation is not head of state . This position is not held by one individual , but rather by the whole of the Federal Council , which for example collectively receives foreign heads of state on state visits . The president is ' primus inter pares ' \u2013 first among equals . He or she chairs the Federal Council meetings and mediates in the case of disputes . In urgent situations the president can order precautionary measures . In the unlikely event that the Federal Council is unable to hold either an ordinary or an extraordinary meeting , the president may take a unilateral decision . Vice Presidency Besides the president of the Swiss Confederation , the Federal Assembly also elects the vice president of the Federal Council . The vice president is required to step in and take on all the presidial duties when the president is unable to . The Federal Council may also assign the vice president presidential powers . Representational duties Presidents of the Swiss Confederation have special representational duties during their year of office . Traditionally they give a speech at New Year and on Swiss National Day on 1 August , which is broadcast on radio and television . They also welcome the diplomatic corps \u2013 all foreign ambassadors to Switzerland \u2013 at a New Year\u2019s reception in the Federal Palace . Since the 1990s it has been usual for the President of the Swiss Confederation to go on official visits abroad . The president is also responsible for fostering relations with the cantons . New Year\u2019s addresses National Day addresses The difference between \u2018state\u2019 and \u2018presidential\u2019 visits A Swiss president never pays a state visit , but can still be received for a state visit by a host country . How is that possible ? The question of state visits abroad frequently causes a certain amount of confusion . First of all it is worth pointing out that in Switzerland the president is not the head of state , as is the case in other countries . That role is held by the full Federal Council , but it is extremely rare for all seven members to travel abroad together ( the few exceptions being the opening of the Simplon tunnel in Domodossola in 1906 and occasional stopovers during Federal Council outings \u2013 none of which were considered state visits ) . Given that the Swiss president is not the head of state , formulations such as \u2018the president is paying a state visit to\u2019 or \u2018is currently on a state visit abroad\u2019 are incorrect from a Swiss perspective ; instead it is more accurate to speak of a \u2018presidential visit\u2019 . Question of perspective For the host country , however , the situation is somewhat different . For although no one individual is considered to be head of state in Switzerland , the President of the Swiss Confederation should be accorded the same standing as his or her foreign counterparts when they meet . Quite reasonably , other countries regard these occasions when they invite or receive the Swiss president as a \u2018state visit\u2019 ; the term is therefore perfectly appropriate . It is up to the country issuing the invitation to decide whether it is for a working visit , an official visit or a state visit , with the full honours dictated by protocol . It is all a question of perspective . Swiss presidents only pay presidential visits , but on occasion are received on state visits by their foreign hosts . The concept of the state visit presents no problems when foreign heads of state come to Switzerland , because they are received by all seven members of the Federal Council . Last modification 15 . 01 . 2025
sentence2: La fonction de la pr\u00e9sidence de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration Contrairement \u00e0 d ' autres pays , la Suisse n ' a jamais une seule personne \u00e0 la t\u00eate de l ' \u00c9tat . En sa qualit\u00e9 de \u00ab primus inter pares \u00bb , le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration assume toutefois par tradition un certain nombre de t\u00e2ches et de fonctions pendant son ann\u00e9e de pr\u00e9sidence . La pr\u00e9sidente ou le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration est \u00e9lu ( e ) pour une ann\u00e9e par l ' Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( chambres r\u00e9unies ) . M\u00eame si son titre le sugg\u00e8re , le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration n ' est pas le chef de l ' \u00c9tat : en Suisse , cette fonction n ' est pas assum\u00e9e par une personne seule , mais l ' est par l ' ensemble du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , qui accueille par exemple les chefs d ' \u00c9tat \u00e9trangers lors de leurs visites officielles . Le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration est \u00ab primus inter pares \u00bb , c ' est - \u00e0 - dire premier parmi ses pairs . Il dirige les s\u00e9ances du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et arbitre au besoin la discussion . En cas d ' urgence , il a la comp\u00e9tence d ' ordonner des mesures provisionnelles . S ' il n ' est pas possible de r\u00e9unir le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral en s\u00e9ance ordinaire ou extraordinaire , le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration d\u00e9cide \u00e0 la place de celui - ci . Vice - pr\u00e9sidence L ' Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale \u00e9lit , outre le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , la vice - pr\u00e9sidente ou le vice - pr\u00e9sident du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il assume toutes les obligations du pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration en cas d ' emp\u00eachement de ce dernier . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral peut en outre lui d\u00e9l\u00e9guer certaines attributions pr\u00e9sidentielles . Devoirs de repr\u00e9sentation Le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration assume durant son ann\u00e9e de fonction certains devoirs de repr\u00e9sentation . C ' est traditionnellement lui qui tient les discours t\u00e9l\u00e9vis\u00e9s et radiophoniques pour la nouvelle ann\u00e9e et la f\u00eate nationale du 1er ao\u00fbt . Il accueille en outre le corps diplomatique \u2013 les envoy\u00e9s \u00e9trangers en Suisse \u2013 \u00e0 l\u2019occasion de la r\u00e9ception du Nouvel An au Palais f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Depuis les ann\u00e9es 90 , la r\u00e8gle veut que le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration entreprenne des voyages officiels \u00e0 l ' \u00e9tranger . Il soigne aussi tout particuli\u00e8rement les relations avec les cantons . Visites d\u2019\u00c9tat et visites pr\u00e9sidentielles : clarifions les termes Le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse ne se rend jamais en visite d\u2019\u00c9tat , mais il se peut qu\u2019il soit re\u00e7u en visite d\u2019\u00c9tat . Comment est - ce possible ? Les visites d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger sont r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement source de confusion . Clarifions un premier point : le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration n\u2019est pas le chef de l\u2019\u00c9tat comme le sont les pr\u00e9sidents dans d\u2019autres pays . En Suisse , en effet , cette fonction est d\u00e9volue \u00e0 l\u2019ensemble du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , lequel ne se rend quasiment jamais in corpore \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger ( les exceptions sont rares : inauguration du tunnel du Simplon \u00e0 Domodossola en Italie en 1906 , bref passage \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger lors des excursions du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ) . D\u00e8s lors , comme le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration n\u2019est pas le chef de l\u2019\u00c9tat , des formules telles que \u00ab il effectue une visite d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00bb ou \u00ab il est en visite d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger \u00bb sont erron\u00e9es du point de vue suisse : dans de tels cas de figure , il faudrait parler de \u00ab visite pr\u00e9sidentielle \u00bb . Question de perspective Du point de vue de l\u2019\u00c9tat h\u00f4te , en revanche , les choses sont diff\u00e9rentes . En effet , bien que la fonction de chef d\u2019\u00c9tat ne soit pas exerc\u00e9e par une seule personne en Suisse , il faut que le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration puisse rencontrer les plus hauts repr\u00e9sentants \u00e9trangers d\u2019\u00e9gal \u00e0 \u00e9gal . D\u00e8s lors , les \u00c9tats \u00e9trangers peuvent tr\u00e8s bien inviter le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse \u00ab pour une visite d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00bb ou le \u00ab recevoir en visite d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00bb . Ces formules sont donc correctes . Il revient \u00e0 l\u2019\u00c9tat qui invite un repr\u00e9sentant \u00e9tranger de d\u00e9cider s\u2019il convie son h\u00f4te \u00e0 une visite de travail , \u00e0 une visite officielle ou \u00e0 une visite d\u2019\u00c9tat avec les plus hauts honneurs protocolaires . En r\u00e9sum\u00e9 , tout est une question de perspective . Lorsqu\u2019il se rend \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger , le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse est \u00ab seulement \u00bb en visite pr\u00e9sidentielle , mais il se peut qu\u2019il soit re\u00e7u en visite d\u2019\u00c9tat . La terminologie ne pose pas de probl\u00e8me pour les visites d\u2019\u00c9tat en Suisse , puisque c\u2019est l\u2019ensemble du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral qui accueille les h\u00f4tes .
