sentence1: Winners of the 2021 Watt d ' Or awards The winners of the 2021 Watt d ' Or awards have been chosen ! This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on 7 January 2021 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category Adaptricity AG : Electricity cannot just be wasted \u2013 Adaptricity makes the distribution grids fit for the climate - neutral and renewable energy future The path towards a climate - neutral Switzerland leads through greater electrification and decentralisation as well as increased digitalisation of the energy supply system . Distribution grids have a major role to play in all this . The higher level transmission grid with the large power plants , but increasingly more solar facilities , electro - charging stations , heat pumps , and finally the sockets at the consumer\u2019s home \u201chang\u201d on to these systems . The classical solution up to now has been to expand the distribution grids . A better , more cost - effective and safer solution is offered by start - up company Adaptricity . With its software solutions , Adaptricity delivers smart answers for the planning and transparent monitoring of grids so making distribution grids fit for a climate - neutral and renewable energy friendly future . \u201cRenewable energy\u201d category Romande Energie and ABB Schweiz : A power spot in the Alps \u2013 this alpine reservoir is also a solar power plant High up in the Swiss Alps the atmosphere is rarer , solar radiation is stronger , and in winter the snow reflects the sunlight . Ideal conditions for the production of solar energy , in winter in particular . The west Switzerland based company Romande Energie is using the good alpine conditions to further develop its renewable electricity production and also promote Switzerland\u2019s energy strategy . For these reasons the company has created a power spot on the Lac des Toules reservoir in Valais , at an altitude of 1 , 800 metres above sea level . In addition to energy from hydropower , the reservoir now also provides solar electricity from a floating alpine solar power plant . To realise this facility , which is unique in the world , many technical problems had to be resolved successfully by Romande Energie with the help of ABB Schweiz . Such is the success of the solutions that other energy supply companies both at home and abroad have indicated that they are interested in the project . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category Hydrospider AG , Hyundai Hydrogen Mobility AG , H2 Energy AG , Association pro H2 Mobilit\u00e4t Schweiz : A cycle for renewable hydrogen for heavy goods traffic \u2013 a network of committed companies intends to make heavy goods traffic in Switzerland climate - neutral Hydrogen will play an important role in worldwide efforts toward a climate - neutral energy supply . That is an undisputed fact today . Many countries , the EU included , are busy defining comprehensive hydrogen strategies . This is not just about the security of CO2 - free supply but rather about a market for hydrogen and for other climate - friendly technologies worth billions . Switzerland is playing in the hydrogen \u201cChampions\u2019 League\u201d thanks to a worldwide unique initiative . Hydrospider AG , Hyundai Hydrogen Mobility AG , H2 Energy AG , and Assocation pro H2 Mobilit\u00e4t Schweiz are constructing the world\u2019s first commercial cycle for renewable hydrogen . This strongly committed network of companies is driving supply and demand for renewable hydrogen in parallel , without any state funding . The business model comprises hydrogen powered trucks , hydrogen filling stations and production and logistics for renewable hydrogen , Today there are about 50 hydrogen powered lorries in Switzerland ; there will soon be more than 1 , 000 . Other countries are following the development with great interest . \u201cBuildings and spatial development\u201d category Mettiss AG and Beat Kegel : Mr Kegel\u2019s flair for physics \u2013 Mettiss AG and Beat Kegel have transformed an office block from the 1960s from an energy guzzler into a passive house thanks to intelligent planning Most of Switzerland\u2019s older buildings waste energy wholesale . Energy refurbishment costs a lot of money , takes a long time , and the complicated services technology confuses building owners . In St . Gallen there is a newly refurbished office building from the sixties which dispels such thoughts completely . Here Beat Kegel\u2019s energy concept \u2013 \u201cKegel\u2019s Rule\u201d for short \u2013 was implemented in cooperation with the St . Gallen property company Mettiss AG . The refurbishment was realised rapidly and cost - effectively and the building now easily meets the passive house standard . This is due to a cost - effective low - technology heating and ventilation system incorporated in prefabricated parapet elements and connector fans in the doors . The new occupant , the University of St . Gallen , is very pleased with the climate in the rooms and the energy costs . \u201cKegel\u2019s Rule\u201d could catch on in the refurbishment of further office buildings as well as in dwelling house construction and new builds . Umwelt Arena Schweiz and Ren\u00e9 Schmid Architekten AG : With heart and mind towards energy self - sufficiency with interconnection \u2013 the development at M\u00e4nnedorf is a model ecological and economic project In their new development in M\u00e4nnedorf , Walter Schmid , energy pioneer and president of Stiftung Umwelt Arena Schweiz , and his son , architect Ren\u00e9 Schmid , Ren\u00e9 Schmid Architekten AG in Zurich , are relying on energy self - sufficiency with interconnection . The development\u2019s entire annual energy requirement is produced on site in photovoltaic plant in the fa\u00e7ades and on the roof with the additional help of a wind energy plant . However , the buildings are not completely autarchic for energy because they are connected to the electricity and gas grids . Half of the electricity produced on site is used directly by the tenants . The rest is conducted to a power - to - gas facility , converted to renewable gas , and stored to produce electricity and heat in winter . The interconnected grids handle seasonal storage of energy generated on the buildings . A concept that make possible a completely renewable , CO2 - free energy supply and actively contributes to reducing the winter electricity shortfall . sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2021 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2021 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e le 7 janvier 2021 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques Adaptricity AG : Stop au gaspillage de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 \u2013 Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 Adaptricity , les r\u00e9seaux de distribution sont pr\u00eats en vue d\u2019un avenir \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique neutre pour le climat et misant sur les \u00e9nergies renouvelables La voie vers la neutralit\u00e9 climatique en Suisse passe par une forte \u00e9lectrification , une d\u00e9centralisation et aussi par une num\u00e9risation croissante du syst\u00e8me d\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie . Les r\u00e9seaux de distribution jouent un r\u00f4le important . Le r\u00e9seau de transport principal avec les grandes centrales \u00e9lectriques y est \u00abli\u00e9\u00bb , mais aussi de plus en plus d\u2019installations photovolta\u00efques , de stations de recharge pour v\u00e9hicules \u00e9lectriques et de pompes \u00e0 chaleur , sans oublier les prises de courant des consommateurs finaux . Jusqu\u2019\u00e0 pr\u00e9sent , la solution classique passait par l\u2019expansion constante et co\u00fbteuse des r\u00e9seaux de distribution . Adaptricity , une spin - off de l\u2019EPFZ , propose une meilleure solution , moins ch\u00e8re et plus s\u00fbre . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 ses solutions logicielles , elle apporte des r\u00e9ponses intelligentes pour la planification et la surveillance transparente des r\u00e9seaux et pr\u00e9pare les r\u00e9seaux de distribution \u00e0 un avenir \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique neutre pour le climat et misant sur les \u00e9nergies renouvelables . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables Romande \u00c9nergie et ABB Suisse : Une source d\u2019\u00e9nergie au c\u0153ur des Alpes \u2013 Ce lac de retenue dans les Alpes est aussi un parc solaire Au sommet des Alpes suisses , l\u2019atmosph\u00e8re est moins dense , le rayonnement solaire plus \u00e9lev\u00e9 et la neige refl\u00e8te la lumi\u00e8re en hiver : des conditions id\u00e9ales pour la production d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 d\u2019origine solaire , surtout en hiver . L\u2019entreprise d\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie Romande \u00c9nergie met \u00e0 profit ces conditions favorables pour d\u00e9velopper sa production d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 renouvelable et faire avancer la strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique de la Suisse . Le lac des Toules en Valais accueille ainsi d\u00e9sormais le premier parc solaire flottant en milieu alpin , \u00e0 1800 m\u00e8tres d\u2019altitude . En plus de l\u2019\u00e9nergie issue de la force hydraulique , le lac fournit d\u00e9sormais de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 d\u2019origine solaire . En collaboration avec ABB Suisse , Romande \u00c9nergie a r\u00e9ussi \u00e0 r\u00e9soudre les nombreux probl\u00e8mes techniques li\u00e9s aux conditions r\u00e9gnant \u00e0 cette altitude . Le succ\u00e8s de ce parc unique au monde est tel que d\u2019autres entreprises d\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie en Suisse et \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger s\u2019y int\u00e9ressent d\u00e9j\u00e0 . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie Hydrospider AG , Hyundai Hydrogen Mobility AG , H2 Energy AG , association Mobilit\u00e9 H2 Suisse : Un cycle de l\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne renouvelable pour le trafic de poids lourds \u2013 Un r\u00e9seau d\u2019entreprises s\u2019engage pour la neutralit\u00e9 climatique du trafic de poids lourds en Suisse Une chose est s\u00fbre : l\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne jouera un r\u00f4le important en vue d\u2019un approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie neutre sur le plan climatique au niveau mondial . Ce n\u2019est pas pour rien que de nombreux pays ainsi que l\u2019Union europ\u00e9enne d\u00e9finissent des strat\u00e9gies globales pour le d\u00e9veloppement de l\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne . Il ne s\u2019agit pas seulement de questions de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 d\u2019approvisionnement sans \u00e9mission de CO2 , mais aussi d\u2019un march\u00e9 de plusieurs milliards d\u2019euros pour l\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne et d\u2019autres technologies respectueuses du climat . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 un projet unique au monde , la Suisse se classe parmi les pays les plus en avance . Hydrospider AG , Hyundai Hydrogen Mobility AG , H2 Energy AG et l\u2019association Mobilit\u00e9 H2 Suisse d\u00e9veloppent en Suisse le premier cycle commercial d\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne renouvelable au monde . Ce r\u00e9seau d\u2019entreprises fortement engag\u00e9es oeuvre \u00e0 faire progresser en parall\u00e8le l\u2019offre et la demande d\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne renouvelable , sans aide publique . Le mod\u00e8le commercial comprend des camions \u00e0 hydrog\u00e8ne , des stations - service \u00e0 hydrog\u00e8ne ainsi que la production d\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne renouvelable et la logistique correspondante . On compte actuellement une cinquantaine de camions \u00e0 hydrog\u00e8ne en Suisse et ils devraient bient\u00f4t \u00eatre plus d\u2019un millier . Les pays \u00e9trangers suivent ce projet avec beaucoup d\u2019int\u00e9r\u00eat . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace Mettiss AG et Beat Kegel : Beat Kegel a du flair pour la physique \u2013 En collaboration avec Beat Kegel , la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 Mettiss AG a r\u00e9nov\u00e9 un immeuble de bureaux des ann\u00e9es 60 , faisant d\u2019un gouffre \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique une maison passive gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 une planification intelligente La plupart des vieux immeubles de bureaux en Suisse sont des gouffres \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques . Les r\u00e9novations \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques co\u00fbtent cher , durent souvent longtemps et les ma\u00eetres d\u2019ouvrage sont d\u00e9sorient\u00e9s par la technique du b\u00e2timent complexe . \u00c0 Saint - Gall , un immeuble de bureaux des ann\u00e9es 60 fra\u00eechement r\u00e9nov\u00e9 dissipe ces craintes . Le concept \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 par Beat Kegel y a \u00e9t\u00e9 mis en \u0153uvre en collaboration avec Mettiss AG , une soci\u00e9t\u00e9 immobili\u00e8re de Saint - Gall . La r\u00e9novation a \u00e9t\u00e9 rapide et peu co\u00fbteuse et le b\u00e2timent satisfait ais\u00e9ment aux crit\u00e8res d\u2019une maison passive , notamment gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 un syst\u00e8me low - tech peu on\u00e9reux de ventilation et de chauffage avec des \u00e9l\u00e9ments d\u2019all\u00e8ge pr\u00e9fabriqu\u00e9s et \u00e0 une a\u00e9ration en r\u00e9seau au niveau des portes . Le nouveau locataire , en l\u2019occurrence l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de Saint - Gall , est tr\u00e8s satisfait du climat int\u00e9rieur et des co\u00fbts \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques . Le concept de Beat Kegel pourrait faire \u00e9cole pour la r\u00e9novation d\u2019autres immeubles de bureaux ainsi que la construction de logements et de nouveaux b\u00e2timents . Umwelt Arena Schweiz et Ren\u00e9 Schmid Architekten AG : L\u2019autosuffisance \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique en r\u00e9seau ou l\u2019alliance du c\u0153ur et de la raison \u2013 Le lotissement de M\u00e4nnedorf est un projet phare sur le plan \u00e9cologique et \u00e9conomique Dans leur nouveau lotissement de M\u00e4nnedorf , Walter Schmid , pionnier de l\u2019\u00e9nergie et pr\u00e9sident de la fondation Umwelt Arena Schweiz et son fils , Ren\u00e9 Schmid , architecte ( Ren\u00e9 Schmid Architekten AG \u00e0 Zurich ) misent sur l\u2019autosuffisance \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique en r\u00e9seau . L\u2019ensemble des besoins \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques annuels du lotissement sont couverts par des installations photovolta\u00efques en fa\u00e7ade et sur les toits et par des \u00e9oliennes . Les b\u00e2timents ne sont cependant pas autonomes sur le plan \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , mais sont raccord\u00e9s au r\u00e9seau d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 et de gaz . La moiti\u00e9 de l\u2019\u00e9nergie produite est consomm\u00e9e directement sur place par les habitants . L\u2019exc\u00e9dent est transport\u00e9 via le r\u00e9seau d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 jusqu\u2019\u00e0 une installation Power - to - Methan o\u00f9 il est transform\u00e9 en gaz renouvelable . Ce dernier est ensuite stock\u00e9 dans le r\u00e9seau de gaz et remis \u00e0 la disposition des immeubles de M\u00e4nnedorf en hiver pour produire de l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 et de la chaleur . Le stockage saisonnier de l\u2019\u00e9nergie produite s\u2019effectue donc par le biais des r\u00e9seaux interconnect\u00e9s . Ce concept permet non seulement un approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie enti\u00e8rement renouvelable et neutre en CO2 , mais il contribue \u00e9galement activement \u00e0 r\u00e9duire la p\u00e9nurie d\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 en hiver . sentence1: Federal Council Affairs Section The Federal Council Affairs Section deals with government core business . Each year it handles more than 2 , 500 items of business that the departments and the Federal Chancellery present to the Federal Council . It plans the Federal Council meetings , draws up the agenda , runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council . Managing Federal Council meetings The Federal Council holds between 40 and 60 meetings each year . Around 2 , 500 items of business are dealt with during the 100 hours or so of meetings . The Federal Council deals with on average 50 items of business at each weekly meeting . The Federal Council Affairs Section checks that the items of business announced by the departments and the Federal Council are complete and correctly submitted , and that they are sent in on time . Four days before the Federal Council meeting it draws up the agenda . As soon as a department or the Federal Council submits a request , the section opens the joint reports procedure , in which the request is distributed to all other departments and the Federal Chancellery . The joint reports and the responses to them are collected by the Federal Council Affairs Section and noted on a list of differences , which the Federal Council refers to on the day of its meeting when debating and making its decisions . Once the meeting is over , the section draws up the Federal Council decisions and issues them to the departments . Guidelines for Federal Council Affairs The Federal Chancellery is responsible for the joint reporting procedure in accordance with Art . 15 para . 2 of the Government and Administration Organisation Act , It organises the procedure on the basis of guidelines set out in the Red File ( Roter Ordner ) . The guidelines explain how items of business should be prepared and dealt with , and sets out for the departments and Federal Chancellery how to make a request to the Federal Council . It also contains the templates and documents needed to make a request . Managing parliamentary procedural requests and questions Each year the Federal Council Affairs Section also handles around 1 , 300 parliamentary procedural requests made to the Federal Council . These are submitted by one or several members of the National Council or Council of States , a parliamentary committee or group . The Federal Council Affairs Section also organises and coordinates a question - and - answer session held in the National Council at the beginning of the second and third week of a parliamentary session . A Federal Council member answers questions submitted in advance by members of the National Council . About 470 questions are submitted annually .
sentence2: Section Affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral La Section des affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ( SACF ) est au centre de l\u2019activit\u00e9 gouvernementale . Elle traite les quelque 2500 affaires que les d\u00e9partements et la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale soumettent annuellement au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Elle planifie les s\u00e9ances du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , \u00e9labore les ordres du jour , coordonne la proc\u00e9dure de co - rapport et pr\u00e9pare les d\u00e9cisions du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Gestion des s\u00e9ances du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Chaque ann\u00e9e , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral tient pas moins de 40 \u00e0 60 s\u00e9ances , qui durent une centaine d\u2019heures au total et permettent de traiter quelque 2500 affaires . Ainsi , chaque semaine , 50 dossiers lui sont soumis en moyenne pour approbation . La Section s\u2019assure de l\u2019exhaustivit\u00e9 et de la r\u00e9ception , dans les d\u00e9lais , des affaires soumises par les d\u00e9partements et la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Quatre jours avant la s\u00e9ance du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , elle \u00e9tablit l\u2019ordre du jour . D\u00e8s qu\u2019un d\u00e9partement ou la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale d\u00e9pose une proposition , la Section lance une proc\u00e9dure de co - rapport , qui consiste \u00e0 envoyer la proposition aux autres d\u00e9partements et \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Ensuite , elle fait la synth\u00e8se des co - rapports et avis re\u00e7us et les inscrit sur la liste des divergences . Le jour de sa s\u00e9ance , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral se r\u00e9f\u00e9rera \u00e0 cette liste pour discuter des dossiers et prendre des d\u00e9cisions . A l\u2019issue de la r\u00e9union , la Section \u00e9tablit les d\u00e9cisions du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et en informe les d\u00e9partements . Directives sur les affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Aux termes de l\u00b4art . 15 , al . 2 , LOGA , la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale r\u00e8gle la proc\u00e9dure de co - rapport . Les Directives sur les affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral mettent en \u0153uvre ce mandat . L\u2019activit\u00e9 de la Section repose sur les Directives , aussi connues sous le nom de \u00abClasseur rouge\u00bb , qui r\u00e9gissent la pr\u00e9paration et le d\u00e9roulement des affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , qui fixent les proc\u00e9dures \u00e0 suivre et contiennent des mod\u00e8les pour l\u2019\u00e9laboration des propositions adress\u00e9es au gouvernement . Le Classeur rouge est un outil destin\u00e9 \u00e0 faciliter la mise au point des dossiers du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral par les d\u00e9partements et la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Gestion des interventions parlementaires et de l\u2019heure des questions La Section traite en outre les quelque 1300 interventions parlementaires adress\u00e9es annuellement au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral par un ou plusieurs membres du Conseil national ou du Conseil des \u00e9tats , par une commission ou un groupe parlementaire , et elle veille \u00e0 ce qu\u2019une r\u00e9ponse soit donn\u00e9e aux interventions . Au d\u00e9but des deuxi\u00e8me et troisi\u00e8me semaines de la session parlementaire , un repr\u00e9sentant du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral r\u00e9pond , durant l\u2019heure des questions , aux questions d\u2019actualit\u00e9 que des membres du Conseil national auront pos\u00e9es pr\u00e9alablement par \u00e9crit . La Section se charge des travaux pr\u00e9paratoires pour l\u2019heure des questions , et de la coordination des r\u00e9ponses donn\u00e9es par le gouvernement aux 470 questions qu\u2019il re\u00e7oit en moyenne chaque ann\u00e9e .

sentence1: Vice Chancellor Rachel Salzmann Born in 1981 , Rachel Salzmann studied history , media and communication sciences at the University of Bern , graduating in 2007 . She holds an executive master\u2019s of business administration with a specialisation in public management from the Bern University of Applied Sciences . Rachel Salzmann worked at DETEC from 2012 to 2018 , the last four years as a personal assistant to former Federal Councillor Doris Leuthard . She then moved to Credit Suisse Energy Infrastructure Partners AG as head of public and regulatory affairs . Before joining the Federal Chancellery , she headed the CEO staff office at CSS Group , a Swiss health insurance company In the role of vice chancellor since 1 July 2024 , Rachel Salzmann heads the Federal Council sector . There she shares overall responsibility \u2013 in coordination with the federal chancellor and the federal council spokesperson \u2013 for ensuring that preparations for Federal Council meetings and follow - up tasks are completed in a timely manner and to the requisite standard . She also manages seven units with a total staff of around 130 , including the sections responsible for the Federal Chancellery\u2019s language services , official publications and legislation . The resident of Bern is married and has a son . She is a member of The Centre political party . Specialist staff

Avant son arriv\u00e9e \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , elle dirigeait l\u2019\u00e9tat - major de la direction de la caisse d\u2019assurance maladie CSS . sentence1: The energy label for bathroom products This label indicates whether shower heads , fittings and water - saving attachments are energy - efficient by classifying them in categories from A ( high level of efficiency ) to G ( low level of efficiency ) . The aim with this label is to increase people ' s awareness of the need to use hot water more sparingly . This benefits the environment and also reduces costs . The production of hot water requires a great deal of energy \u2013 in a modern house or apartment , often more than is required for room heating . Swiss Association for Energy - Efficient Sanitary Products SVES The \u201cSchweizerischer Verband f\u00fcr energieeffiziente Sanit\u00e4rprodukte SVES\u201d ( Swiss Association for Energy - Efficient Sanitary Products ) took over in 2016 the responsibility for the energy label regarding bathroom products in Switzerland . sentence2: L\u2019\u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie pour appareils sanitaires L ' \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie pour appareils sanitaires indique d ' un coup d ' oeil si un pommeau de douche , un robinet ou un \u00e9conomiseur d ' eau consomme peu ( classe A ) ou beaucoup d ' \u00e9nergie ( classe G ) . La prise de conscience devrait inciter \u00e0 plus de retenue dans l ' utilisation d ' eau chaude . Les bienfaits se feront sentir autant pour l ' environnement que pour le porte - monnaie de l ' usager . En effet , la production d ' eau chaude n\u00e9cessite beaucoup d ' \u00e9nergie - dans un m\u00e9nage habitant un b\u00e2timent moderne , souvent plus que le chauffage . Association suisse pour les appareils sanitaires \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement efficients , SVES Au b\u00e9n\u00e9fice d ' une convention de collaboration avec l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie , l ' association suisse pour les appareils sanitaires \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement efficients SVES promeut et g\u00e8re l ' \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie pour les appareils sanitaires . sentence1: Central Language Services , German Section The German Section in the Federal Chancellery Central Language Services ensures the clarity of official texts and contributes to the success of multilingual official communication . Legal drafting Within the framework of the Internal Drafting Committee ( VIRK ) , the German Section ensures that legislative texts are precise , clear , non - contradictory and formulated as simply as possible . Texts must also correspond in the three official languages . The section also checks the clarity and linguistic quality of other official texts , for example reports and statements by the Federal Council . Translation The German Section translates into German texts produced by the Federal Chancellery or for the Presidial Services , and checks the quality of translations produced for the federal authorities in the departments and offices . It thereby contributes to the quality of multilingual official communication . Language policy The German Section is active in national and international bodies that deal with language policy , for example the Rat f\u00fcr deutsche Rechtschreibung . It contributes the Federal Administration\u2019s position and represents the interests of Switzerland . Linguistic advice The German Section produces guidelines and other aids to facilitate the writing of official texts and ensure consistency between them . The section also advises Federal Administration employees and the public on linguistic issues . Training The German Section is active in the training of legal drafters ( Murtner Gesetzgebungsseminare , Gesetzgebungskurs des Bundes , Rechtsetzungsforum ) and employees of the Language Services ( courses on style guides , German translators\u2019 network ) . Further information Links Languages Publications on language issues Documents Flyer Language Services Fed . Adm . ( PDF , 1 MB , 24 . 05 . 2013 )
sentence2: Services linguistiques centraux , Section allemande La Section allemande des Services linguistiques centraux de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale veille \u00e0 l\u2019intelligibilit\u00e9 des textes officiels et contribue au bon fonctionnement de la communication plurilingue des autorit\u00e9s . R\u00e9daction l\u00e9gislative Dans le cadre de la Commission interne de r\u00e9daction ( CIR ) , la Section allemande veille \u00e0 ce que les textes de loi soient formul\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re pr\u00e9cise , claire , coh\u00e9rente et aussi simple que possible , et elle s\u2019assure de la concordance des versions dans les trois langues officielles . Elle examine encore d\u2019autres documents des autorit\u00e9s , tels que des rapports ou avis du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , pour qu\u2019ils soient compr\u00e9hensibles et de bonne facture sur le plan linguistique . Traduction La Section allemande traduit en allemand des textes pour la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et la pr\u00e9sidence de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , et v\u00e9rifie la traduction de documents des autorit\u00e9s \u00e9manant des d\u00e9partements et des offices de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Elle contribue ainsi \u00e0 une communication plurilingue de qualit\u00e9 \u00e9lev\u00e9e de la part des autorit\u00e9s . Politique linguistique La Section allemande si\u00e8ge dans diff\u00e9rentes organisations suisses et internationales d\u00e9di\u00e9es \u00e0 la politique linguistique , comme le Conseil de l\u2019orthographe allemande ( Rat f\u00fcr deutsche Rechtschreibung ) . Elle leur apporte l\u2019\u00e9clairage de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale suisse et elle repr\u00e9sente les int\u00e9r\u00eats de notre pays . Conseils en mati\u00e8re linguistique La Section allemande publie des guides et aide - m\u00e9moire destin\u00e9s \u00e0 faciliter la r\u00e9daction de documents officiels et \u00e0 rendre leur pr\u00e9sentation homog\u00e8ne . Elle conseille en outre les employ\u00e9s de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et les citoyens sur les questions linguistiques . Formations La Section allemande participe aux formations de base et d\u2019approfondissement destin\u00e9s aux sp\u00e9cialistes charg\u00e9s d\u2019\u00e9laborer des actes normatifs ( s\u00e9minaires de l\u00e9gistique de Morat , cours de l\u00e9gislation de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , forum de l\u00e9gislation ) et aux employ\u00e9s des services linguistiques ( cours portant sur les aide - m\u00e9moire , r\u00e9seau des traducteurs germanophones ) . Informations compl\u00e9mentaires Liens Langues Documents en allemand Documents Brochure Services linguistiques adm . f\u00e9d . ( PDF , 1 MB , 24 . 05 . 2013 )

sentence1: Winners of the 2016 Watt d ' Or awards The winners of the 2016 Watt d ' Or awards have been chosen ! This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on the occasion of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy ' s New Year ' s event that was held on 7 January 2016 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cSociety\u201d category Groupe E \u2013 RoadLab To celebrate the 100th anniversary of its parent company and with the aim of looking to the future instead of merely taking stock of its past , Groupe E created RoadLab \u2013 a double - decker bus designed as a laboratory for carrying out energy - related experiments intended for pupils aged between 13 and 16 . This project was launched as part of the celebrations of the 10th anniversary of Groupe E and more than 100 years of activity of its parent company in the energy sector . Since the beginning of 2015 , the mobile laboratory has been paying highly successful visits to all the secondary schools in the cantons of Fribourg and Neuch\u00e2tel , as well as in the Broye and Pays - d ' Enhaut regions in the canton of Vaud , that are connected to the Group E distribution network . The 2016 Watt d ' Or in the \u201cSociety\u201d category was awarded to Group E in recognition of its action aimed at bringing the fascinating world of energy closer to young adults . \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category Elektroplan Buchs & Grossen AG and ElektroLink AG \u2013 smart - grid - ready building Smart - grid - ready office complex in Frutigen ready for the intelligent , networked energy future : thanks to intelligent control mechanisms and optimised load management , this energy - efficient office complex demonstrates how energy consumption and solar electricity production can be optimally harmonised via a building ' s roof . The 2016 Watt d ' Or in the \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category was awarded to Elektroplan Buchs & Grossen AG and ElektroLink AG for demonstrating that Swiss energy planners can make our buildings fit for the future . \u201cRenewable energies\u201d category Designergy SA \u2013 Triactive Core Roof ( TCR ) Integration is the guiding principle for Designergy SA , based in San Vittore ( canton of Grisons ) . This is not only reflected in the name of this young company \u2013 integration is also the centre of focus of its visionary product . In the same way as the functions of phone , camera and computer can be integrated in a single device , the new roof element called Triactive Core Roof ( TCR ) combines three main functions : heat insulation , waterproofing and electricity production , all prefabricated and fully integrated into the roof . The 2016 Watt d ' Or in the \u201cRenewable energies\u201d category was awarded to Designergy AG for its development of a global innovation that stands out not only for its ease and speed of installation , but also for its excellence of design and low cost . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category SBB AG \u2013 Gr\u00fcne Welle im Bahnverkehr \u2013 ADL ( adaptive energy control system ) As part of its energy strategy , Swiss Federal Railways ( SBB ) aims to be able to consistently save energy groupwide \u2013 and in particular reduce the electricity consumption of its passenger and goods trains \u2013 within the next decade . At present , the annual consumption of Europe ' s densest railway network is over 1 , 800 gigawatt hours , which is equivalent to the level of consumption in 46 , 000 households . ADL , the SBB ' s adaptive energy control system , is able to make a significant contribution towards its energy - efficiency programme . It calculates an optimal energy consumption profile for each train and passes on a recommendation to the train crew regarding the ideal travel speed in terms of energy efficiency . This means that unscheduled stops and braking manoeuvres , and above all the energy - intensive restarting of the train , can be avoided . The 2016 Watt d ' Or in the \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category was awarded to Swiss Federal Railways for its innovative ADL system , which is the first of its kind in the world and has already been operating successfully for around a year . \u201cBuildings and space\u201d category Swisscom AG and Ernst Basler + Partner \u2013 Swisscom Businesspark Ittigen Swisscom ' s new \u201cBusiness Park Ittigen\u201d complex is located directly alongside the A1 motorway outside Bern . The outstanding feature of this complex is its consistent adaptation of technology to the building . In combination with the installation of an innovative automated ventilation system , an outstanding overall concept was developed for this project : the complex is especially noteworthy for its degree of comfort and its energy - efficient design , which meets the requirements of the Minergie - P - Eco standard , as well as for its low operating costs and high degree of operational safety . For this groundbreaking project , Swisscom AG and Ernst Basler + Partner ( EBP ) were awarded the 2016 Watt d ' Or in the \u201cBuildings and space\u201d category . Special \u201cCorporate strategy\u201d award Coop Group \u2013 energy and CO2 vision : deeds instead of words CO2 neutrality , reduction of absolute energy consumption by 20 percent versus 2008 , and increasing the proportion of renewable energy to 80 percent : these are the declared goals Coop aims to achieve by 2023 . And the retailer is well on track , having already succeeded in reducing its energy consumption by around 6 percent and its CO2 emissions by more than 20 percent by 2014 . Coop was awarded the 2016 Watt d ' Or in the special \u201cCorporate strategy\u201d category for these ambitious targets , which are embedded in a comprehensive sustainability strategy . Migros \u2013 Generation M Migros has been committed to energy efficiency and other areas of sustainability for several decades , and has been awarded the 2016 Watt d ' Or in the special \u201cCorporate strategy\u201d category for its Generation M sustainability programme , in which it has declared its intention to reduce absolute electricity consumption by 10 percent , and greenhouse gas emissions by 20 percent versus the 2010 level , by 2020 . Documents Watt d ' Or 2016 Links Gallery of photos taken at the awards ceremony on 7 January 2016 Watt d ' Or on Youtube Media Press releases in German Last modification 07 . 01 . 2016
sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2016 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2016 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e \u00e0 l ' occasion de l ' ap\u00e9ritif du Nouvel An organis\u00e9 par l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie , le 7 janvier 2016 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 Groupe E \u2013 RoadLabA l ' occasion de son centenaire , Groupe E ne s ' est pas content\u00e9 de regarder en arri\u00e8re . En cr\u00e9ant RoadLab , un bus \u00e0 deux \u00e9tages qui sert de laboratoire pour les \u00e9l\u00e8ves du cycle d ' orientation \u00e2g\u00e9s de 13 \u00e0 16 ans , il se tourne r\u00e9solument vers l ' avenir . Ce projet est men\u00e9 dans le cadre du dixi\u00e8me anniversaire de Groupe E et de plus de 100 ans d ' activit\u00e9 dans le domaine de l ' \u00e9nergie de sa soci\u00e9t\u00e9 fondatrice . Depuis le d\u00e9but de 2015 , ce laboratoire itin\u00e9rant sillonne les cantons de Fribourg , Neuch\u00e2tel et Vaud ( notamment dans la Broye et le Pays - d ' Enhaut ) qui font partie du r\u00e9seau de distribution de Groupe E . Le Watt d ' Or 2016 de la cat\u00e9gorie soci\u00e9t\u00e9 est d\u00e9cern\u00e9 \u00e0 Groupe E qui permet aux jeunes de se familiariser avec le monde fascinant de l ' \u00e9nergie . Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques Elektroplan Buchs & Grossen AG et ElektroLink AG \u2013 Immeuble SmartGridreadyL ' immeuble de bureaux SmartGridready de Frutigen est pr\u00eat pour l ' avenir \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique intelligent et interconnect\u00e9 . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 un syst\u00e8me domotique et \u00e0 une gestion optimis\u00e9e du courant , cet immeuble \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement efficace d\u00e9montre comment la consommation \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et la production de courant solaire peuvent \u00eatre harmonis\u00e9es de mani\u00e8re optimale . Le Watt d ' Or 2016 dans la cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques est d\u00e9cern\u00e9 \u00e0 Elektroplan Buchs & Grossen AG et ElektroLink AG qui ont prouv\u00e9 que des \u00e9lectro - planificateurs suisses peuvent \u00e9quiper nos b\u00e2timents pour l ' avenir . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables Designergy SA \u2013 L ' \u00e9l\u00e9ment de toiture innovant TCRL ' int\u00e9gration est le leitmotiv de Designergy SA , \u00e0 San Vittore dans le canton des Grisons . Cela appara\u00eet d\u00e9j\u00e0 dans le nom de la jeune entreprise , un mot - valise qui combine design et \u00e9nergie . L ' int\u00e9gration est aussi \u00e0 la base de son produit visionnaire : \u00e0 l ' instar d ' un Smartphone r\u00e9unissant les fonctions de t\u00e9l\u00e9phone , de cam\u00e9ra et d ' ordinateur , l ' \u00e9l\u00e9ment de toiture innovant nomm\u00e9 TCR ( Triactive Core Roof ) a trois fonctions essentielles : isolation thermique , \u00e9tanch\u00e9it\u00e9 \u00e0 l ' eau et production d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 issue du photovolta\u00efque , le tout pr\u00e9fabriqu\u00e9 et int\u00e9gr\u00e9 en une seule unit\u00e9 . Le Watt d ' Or 2016 dans la cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables est d\u00e9cern\u00e9 \u00e0 Designergy SA pour une nouveaut\u00e9 mondiale qui s\u00e9duit non seulement par son installation simple et rapide , mais \u00e9galement par son design attrayant et ses faibles co\u00fbts . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie CFF SA \u2013 Vague verte dans le trafic ferroviaire \u2013 ADL Dans le cadre de leur strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , les Chemins de fer f\u00e9d\u00e9raux ( CFF ) visent de fortes \u00e9conomies d ' \u00e9nergie \u00e0 l ' \u00e9chelle du groupe d ' ici 2025 , en particulier dans la consommation d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 de leurs trains voyageurs et trains de marchandises . De fait , leur r\u00e9seau ferroviaire , le plus fr\u00e9quent\u00e9 d ' Europe , utilise chaque ann\u00e9e plus de 1800 gigawattheures d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 , soit autant que 460 000 foyers . Le syst\u00e8me de r\u00e9gulation adaptative des trains appel\u00e9 \u00abvague verte\u00bb ( ou ADL ) apporte une large contribution au programme d ' \u00e9conomie d ' \u00e9nergie . Durant chaque trajet , ce syst\u00e8me calcule la meilleure courbe de vitesse du point de vue \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et signale au conducteur , \u00e0 titre de conseil , quelle vitesse convient le mieux . Cette mesure permet d ' \u00e9viter des freinages voire des arr\u00eats impr\u00e9vus et surtout des red\u00e9marrages \u00e9nergivores . Le Watt d ' Or 2016 de la cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie est attribu\u00e9 aux CFF pour ce syst\u00e8me de r\u00e9gulation innovant , unique au monde , exploit\u00e9 avec succ\u00e8s depuis une ann\u00e9e . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace Swisscom AG et Ernst Basler + Partner \u2013 Nouvel immeuble Swisscom Businesspark Ittigen Le \u00abBusiness Park\u00bb , nouveau b\u00e2timent Swisscom \u00e0 Ittigen , s ' \u00e9l\u00e8ve \u00e0 proximit\u00e9 imm\u00e9diate de l ' autoroute A1 . Sa particularit\u00e9 tient \u00e0 l ' intelligente ad\u00e9quation de la technologie avec le b\u00e2timent . Cette approche , combin\u00e9e \u00e0 une ventilation d ' un type novateur , analogue \u00e0 un poumon , a donn\u00e9 naissance \u00e0 une conception d ' ensemble exceptionnelle : si le nouveau b\u00e2timent a bien s\u00fbr de quoi convaincre en mati\u00e8re d ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( Minergie - P - Eco ) et de confort , ses atouts rel\u00e8vent aussi des co\u00fbts et de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 d ' exploitation . Ce projet pionnier vaut \u00e0 Swisscom SA et au bureau Ernst Basler + Partner ( EBP ) le Watt d ' Or 2016 dans la cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace . Prix sp\u00e9cial \u00abStrat\u00e9gie d ' entreprise\u00bb Coop \u2013 Vision en mati\u00e8re d ' \u00e9nergie et de CO2 : des paroles aux actes Neutralit\u00e9 au niveau du CO2 , r\u00e9duction de la consommation absolue d ' \u00e9nergie de 20 % et rel\u00e8vement de la part des \u00e9nergies renouvelables \u00e0 80 % \u2013 voil\u00e0 les objectifs d\u00e9clar\u00e9s de Coop jusqu ' en 2023 . Le grand distributeur est sur la bonne voie : de 2008 \u00e0 2014 , sa consommation \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique a d\u00e9j\u00e0 baiss\u00e9 d ' environ 6 % et les \u00e9missions de CO2 de plus de 20 % . Pour cet objectif ambitieux int\u00e9gr\u00e9 dans une vaste strat\u00e9gie de d\u00e9veloppement durable , Coop se voit d\u00e9cerner un prix sp\u00e9cial Watt d ' Or 2016 \u00abstrat\u00e9gie d ' entreprise\u00bb . Migros \u2013 G\u00e9n\u00e9ration MDepuis des d\u00e9cennies , l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et d ' autres th\u00e8mes li\u00e9s au d\u00e9veloppement durable sont au c\u0153ur des pr\u00e9occupations de Migros . Le jury du Watt d ' Or a d\u00e9cid\u00e9 de d\u00e9cerner un prix sp\u00e9cial 2016 au programme G\u00e9n\u00e9ration M , dans lequel Migros promet \u00e0 la g\u00e9n\u00e9ration de demain de r\u00e9duire sa consommation d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 de 10 % et ses \u00e9missions de gaz \u00e0 effet de serre de 20 % d ' ici 2020 par rapport \u00e0 2010 . Documents Watt d ' Or 2016 Liens Photos de la remise des prix du 7 janvier 2016 Watt d ' Or sur Youtube M\u00e9dias L\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie d\u00e9cerne pour la dixi\u00e8me fois le Watt d\u2019Or , le prix suisse de l\u2019\u00e9nergie Derni\u00e8re modification 07 . 01 . 2016

sentence1: Crisis Management The Federal Chancellery supports and advises the departments in preparing for and managing interdepartmental crises . It carries out its crisis management tasks in accordance with the Government and Administration Organisation Act ( GAOA ) and the Ordinance on the Crisis Organisation of the Federal Administration ( OCOFA ) . The Federal Council has also entrusted the Federal Chancellery with managing the Integrated Exercise 2025 ( IE 25 ) , a nationwide crisis exercise . The tasks of the Federal Chancellery in the area of crisis management have increased significantly since the evaluations of the Federal Administration ' s crisis management during the COVID - 19 pandemic . The Federal Chancellery works closely with the departments and cantonal stakeholders in implementing these tasks . The Federal Chancellery crisis management tasks include : The Integrated Exercise 2025 ( IE 25 ) planned for November 2025 will review the new crisis organisation of the Federal Administration and that of the cantons . A Strategic Leadership Exercise ( SLU ) and a Swiss Security Network Exercise ( SNE ) will be combined for the first time . The federal and cantonal governments share responsibility for planning , execution and evaluation . On 29 March 2023 , the Federal Council took a landmark decision on optimising its crisis management at a time of increasing global uncertainty . The focus is on managing emerging crises within the existing structures of the Federal Administration for as long as possible , but with accelerated procedures to increase efficiency . In addition , the early detection of crises is to be strengthened in order to be able to react to changes in the situation in a timely manner . The new Ordinance on the Crisis Organisation of the Federal Administration ( OCOFA ) was drafted on the basis of the Federal Council ' s decision . The focus is on the Federal Administration ' s realigned crisis management with three key elements : Holistic approach to crisis management Another important component of the Federal Administration ' s new crisis organisation is how to systematically include the cantons , the scientific community and , if necessary , other stakeholders in crisis teams . This measure promotes a holistic approach to crisis management and ensures that all necessary interest groups are appropriately represented . Furthermore , the OCOFA has created the legal basis for federal employees to be deployed temporarily for Federal Administration crisis management when necessary ( \u2018Federal Administration personnel pool\u2019 ) . Online learning module of the OCOFA Ordinance Link The Organisation for Crisis Management website provides two online training modules on crisis management in the Federal Administration . They are available to the general public ( de , fr , it ) . Further informations Documents Verbesserte Krisenorganisation der Bundesverwaltung . M\u00e4rz 2021 und 22 . 3343 Gr\u00fcnliberale Fraktion vom 18 . M\u00e4rz 2022 ( PDF , 456 kB , 16 . 02 . 2024 ) All documents about the crisis management of the Federal Administration available in German under : Documentation crisis management Media releases Link to the press release in German , French and Italian : The Federal Council improves the crisis organisation of the Federal Administration December 20 , 2024 The Federal Council is improving the crisis organisation of the Federal Administration : At its meeting on 20 December 2024 , it approved the Ordinance on the Crisis Organisation of the Federal Administration ( KOBV ) and put it into effect on 1 February 2025 . The aim of this ordinance is to create the necessary conditions for the rapid and systematic deployment of the interdepartmental crisis teams and thus to prepare the Federal Administration for crisis situations more efficiently and effectively . Federal Council improves crisis management structures The Federal Council aims to be better prepared for crisis situations and have more efficient mechanisms in place for dealing with them . At its meeting on 29 March , it decided , based on the lessons learned from the COVID - 19 pandemic , to strengthen the organisation of the Federal Administration so it is better equipped for future crises . In the event of complex crises , the Federal Council will be able to deploy crisis units at both a strategic and operational level . The Federal Council remains the supreme governing authority . In addition , a Standing Core Unit will provide crisis management support to the departmental staff offices . The Federal Council has tasked the Federal Department of Defence , Civil Protection and Sport DDPS and the Federal Chancellery FCh with drawing up core legislation on the new crisis management structure by the end of 2023 . sentence2: Gestion des crises La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale conseille et soutient les d\u00e9partements dans la pr\u00e9paration aux crises d\u2019envergure et dans la gestion de celles - ci . Elle assume plusieurs t\u00e2ches en mati\u00e8re de gestion de crise en vertu de la loi sur l\u2019organisation du gouvernement et de l\u2019administration ( LOGA ) et en vertu de l\u2019ordonnance sur l\u2019organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( OCAF ) . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral l\u2019a en outre charg\u00e9e de diriger l\u2019exercice int\u00e9gr\u00e9 2025 ( EI 25 ) , un exercice de crise \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle nationale . Les t\u00e2ches de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( ChF ) dans le domaine de la gestion de crise ont consid\u00e9rablement augment\u00e9 depuis les \u00e9valuations sur la mani\u00e8re dont l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale a g\u00e9r\u00e9 la pand\u00e9mie de COVID - 19 . Pour les mener \u00e0 bien , la ChF collabore \u00e9troitement avec les d\u00e9partements et les acteurs cantonaux . Dans le domaine de la gestion des crises , la ChF fournit notamment les prestations suivantes : L\u2019EI 25 permettra , en novembre 2025 , de mettre \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9preuve la nouvelle organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et celle des cantons . C\u2019est la premi\u00e8re fois que l\u2019on combinera un exercice de conduite strat\u00e9gique ( ECS ) et un exercice du R\u00e9seau national de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 ( ERNS ) . La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et les cantons partagent la responsabilit\u00e9 de planifier , de r\u00e9aliser et d\u2019\u00e9valuer l\u2019exercice . Dans un contexte d\u2019incertitudes croissantes au niveau mondial , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a pris , d\u00e8s le 29 mars 2023 , une d\u00e9cision de principe pour optimiser sa gestion de crise . Il s\u2019agit de g\u00e9rer les crises \u00e9mergentes aussi longtemps que possible au sein des structures d\u00e9j\u00e0 en place de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , mais en acc\u00e9l\u00e9rant les processus pour augmenter l\u2019efficience . Par ailleurs , il importe de renforcer la d\u00e9tection pr\u00e9coce des crises pour pouvoir r\u00e9agir en temps voulu aux changements de situation . La nouvelle ordonnance sur l\u2019organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( OCAF ) se fonde sur la d\u00e9cision de principe du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . La gestion de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale s\u2019articule d\u00e9sormais autour de trois piliers . Une approche globale de la gestion de crise L\u2019int\u00e9gration syst\u00e9matique des cantons , des milieux scientifiques et , au besoin , d\u2019autres acteurs importants dans les \u00e9tats - majors de crise est un \u00e9l\u00e9ment essentiel de la nouvelle organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Il s\u2019agit d\u2019encourager une approche globale de la gestion de crise et d\u2019assurer une repr\u00e9sentation \u00e9quitable de tous les groupes d\u2019int\u00e9r\u00eat concern\u00e9s . Par ailleurs , l\u2019OCAF pose les fondements juridiques pour l\u2019engagement de personnel auxiliaire ( pool de personnel de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ) lorsque les unit\u00e9s administratives enregistrent des besoins suppl\u00e9mentaires importants , exceptionnels et limit\u00e9s dans le temps . Modules de formation en ligne en lien avec l\u2019OCAF Lien Les deux modules de formation en ligne sont en libre acc\u00e8s sur le site Internet de l\u2019organisation de base de gestion de crise ( OBGC ) . ( ) Informations compl\u00e9mentaires Documents Am\u00e9lioration de l ' organisation de crise de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Rapport du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral en ex\u00e9cution des postulats 21 . 3205 Groupe RL du 17 mars 2021 , 21 . 3449 de la Commission de la politique de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 du Conseil des \u00c9tats du 25 mars 2021 et 22 . 3343 du Groupe GL du 18 mars 2022 ( PDF , 498 kB , 27 . 03 . 2023 ) Tous les documents \u00e0 propos la gestion des crises de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sont disponibles sous : Documentation gestion des crises Communiqu\u00e9s de presse Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral am\u00e9liore l\u2019organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral am\u00e9liore l\u2019organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale : lors de sa s\u00e9ance du 20 d\u00e9cembre 2024 , il a approuv\u00e9 l\u2019ordonnance sur l\u2019organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( OCAF ) , qui entrera en vigueur le 1er f\u00e9vrier 2025 . Le but de cette ordonnance est de cr\u00e9er les conditions n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 une intervention rapide et syst\u00e9matique des \u00e9tats - majors de crise suprad\u00e9partementaux et , par cons\u00e9quent , de mieux pr\u00e9parer l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale aux situations de crise . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral am\u00e9liore l\u2019organisation de la gestion de crise Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral doit \u00eatre mieux pr\u00e9par\u00e9 aux crises et soutenu plus efficacement dans la gestion de celles - ci . Se fondant sur les enseignements tir\u00e9s de la pand\u00e9mie de COVID - 19 , il a d\u00e9cid\u00e9 le 29 mars 2023 de renforcer l\u2019organisation de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale pour les crises \u00e0 venir . En cas de crise complexe , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral pourra d\u00e9cider de constituer un \u00e9tat - major de crise aux niveaux politico - strat\u00e9gique et op\u00e9rationnel . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral demeure l\u2019autorit\u00e9 directoriale et ex\u00e9cutive supr\u00eame . En outre , un \u00e9tat - major central permanent soutiendra les \u00e9tats - majors des d\u00e9partements dans la gestion de crise . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a charg\u00e9 le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la d\u00e9fense , de la protection de la population et des sports et la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale d\u2019\u00e9laborer les bases l\u00e9gales n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 la nouvelle organisation de crise d\u2019ici \u00e0 la fin 2023 . Bases l\u00e9gales Loi sur l\u2019organisation du gouvernement et de l\u2019administration ( LOGA ) Ordonnance sur l\u2019organisation de crise de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale Liens Modules WBT pour la gestion des crises dans l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale

sentence1: Solar Energy at High Temperature Solar power systems concentrate direct solar radiation turning it into a high - temperature energy source for the generation of electricity or to trigger chemical reactions . In this process , mirrors focus solar radiation onto receivers placed at the focal point , or in the focal line , of the system , where energy is either conveyed to a heat transfer medium or used directly . Electricity production costs at solar thermal power plants ( STE ) are higher than those for photovoltaic systems . However , the technology brings advantages in respect of integration into the energy system , which means photovoltaic systems and STE could well complement each other . Current research priorities Priorities of the research promoted by the SFOE : Links ARAMIS Specialist staff Last modification 16 . 11 . 2017
sentence2: Energie solaire \u00e0 haute temp\u00e9rature Les syst\u00e8mes solaires \u00e0 concentration transforment la radiation solaire directe en source d ' \u00e9nergie \u00e0 haute temp\u00e9rature pour produire de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 ou pour entra\u00eener des r\u00e9actions chimiques . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 des miroirs , la radiation solaire est concentr\u00e9e sur un r\u00e9cepteur de chaleur ( receiver ) positionn\u00e9 en pleine lumi\u00e8re / sur la ligne focale , o\u00f9 l ' \u00e9nergie est transmise sur un fluide caloporteur ou directement utilis\u00e9e . Les co\u00fbts de production de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 des centrales solaires thermiques sont plus \u00e9lev\u00e9s que ceux des syst\u00e8mes photovolta\u00efques . Cependant , la technologie pr\u00e9sente des avantages quant \u00e0 l ' int\u00e9gration dans le syst\u00e8me \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , de telle sorte que le photovolta\u00efque et la centrale solaire thermique pourraient ais\u00e9ment se compl\u00e9ter . sentence1: SWEET : Integration of renewables The guiding theme of SWEET Call 1 - 2020 is \u201cIntegration of renewables into a sustainable and resilient Swiss energy system\u201d . This theme has been broken down into the following research challenges : SWEET Leitthema SWEET - Bild 1 e Renewables must be integrated into the Swiss energy system in order to ensure that demand is met ; storage is available where and when needed ; energy conversion is efficient , climate - neutral and net - negative . Furthermore , they must be integrated in such a way as to be of optimum value to the Swiss economy and society and also form part of the overall European energy system . The SWEET Call 1 - 2020 ran from 25 June to 12 October 2020 . The 13 applications submitted were assessed by external experts and for each research challenge the top ranked consortium was selected : CROSS CROSS ( CooRdination Of Scenarios for SWEET ) is a joint activity of the four consortia DeCarbCH , EDGE , PATHFNDR and SURE , supported by the SWEET programme and coordinated by ETH Zurich . The objective of CROSS is to ensure that scenario analyses are compared in a meaningful manner and that credible conclusions are drawn . The main tasks of CROSS are to harmonise assumptions and scenarios , to document them together with the results and to make them publicly available . CoSi Call 1 - 2022 CROSS completed its activities at the beginning of 2023 and is continuing as CROSS + as part of the CoSi consortium from the . Ce th\u00e8me a \u00e9t\u00e9 subdivis\u00e9 en quatre Research Challenges : SWEET Leitthema SWEET - Bild 1 f Les \u00e9nergies renouvelables doivent \u00eatre int\u00e9gr\u00e9es dans le syst\u00e8me \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique de la Suisse afin que : les besoins soient couverts ; des possibilit\u00e9s de stockage soient disponibles \u00e0 l\u2019endroit et au moment o\u00f9 elles sont n\u00e9cessaires ; la conversion de l\u2019\u00e9nergie soit efficace , neutre sur le plan climatique et n\u00e9gative en termes d\u2019\u00e9missions nettes ; l\u2019int\u00e9gration soit d\u2019une valeur optimale pour l\u2019\u00e9conomie et la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 suisses ; l\u2019int\u00e9gration dans le syst\u00e8me \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique europ\u00e9en soit assur\u00e9e dans son ensemble . Le premier appel d\u2019offres SWEET de 2020 ( SWEET Call 1 - 2020 ) a \u00e9t\u00e9 lanc\u00e9 le 25 juin 2020 et a dur\u00e9 jusqu\u2019au 12 octobre 2020 . Les 13 propositions re\u00e7ues ont \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9valu\u00e9es par des experts internationaux et le consortium le mieux class\u00e9 pour chaque Research Challenge a \u00e9t\u00e9 s\u00e9lectionn\u00e9 : CROSS CROSS ( CooRdination Of Scenarios for SWEET ) est une activit\u00e9 conjointe des quatre consortiums DeCarbCH , EDGE , PATHFNDR et SURE , soutenue par le programme SWEET et coordonn\u00e9e par l ' EPF Zurich . L\u2019objectif de CROSS est de garantir que les analyses de sc\u00e9narios soient compar\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re pertinente et que des conclusions fiables puissent en \u00eatre tir\u00e9es . sentence1: Organisation of the Federal Chancellery The Federal Chancellery with its staff of some 340 people has been headed by Federal Chancellor Viktor Rossi since January 2024 . Federal Chancellor Sector Political Rights Section The is responsible for ensuring that political rights are enacted , for preparing for federal ballots and for coordinating the introduction of electronic voting by the cantons . Communications and Strategy Sector Communications Section The at the Federal Chancellery coordinates Federal Council communication with the media , public , cantons and Parliament . Communication Support Section The section advises and supports the Federal Administration in all matters relating to communication and creates a wide range of communication products . Strategic Management Support Section The has the task of drafting the Federal Council ' s planning and activity reports and supports the departments in crisis management . Presidential Services Unit The , which has been part of the Federal Chancellery since 2015 , supports the president\u2019s department in carrying out the additional tasks arising in the presidential year . In particular , the provides advice on matters of diplomacy and communication . Federal Council Sector Federal Council Affairs Section The deals with government core business . Each year it handles more than 2 , 500 items of business that the departments and the Federal Chancellery present to the Federal Council . It plans the Federal Council meetings , draws up the agenda , runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council . Legal Section The provides support to the Federal Council Affairs Section and is responsible for legislation on administrative organisation , the consultation procedure and publications . Official Publications Centre ( OPC ) The Official Publications Centre plays a key role in the Federal Administration , helping the federal offices to prepare texts for publication in the Federal Gazette or the Official Compilation , and keeping law texts in the Classified Compilation up to date . Central Language Services , German Section The German Section in the Federal Chancellery Central Language Services ensures the clarity of official texts and contributes to the success of multilingual official communication . Central Language Services French Section The French Section in the Central Language Services helps draft laws , translates and revises texts . It provides services to Parliament , the Federal Council , the federal departments and the Federal Chancellery . Central Language Services , Italian Division The Italian Division of the Central Language Services is the oldest language service at the Federal Chancellery . It comprises the Legislation and Language Section , based in Bern , and the Translation and Editing Section , based in Bellinzona . Central Language Services , Terminology Section The Terminology Section in the Federal Chancellery\u2019s Central Language Services provides relevant and up - to - date terminology in the four national languages and in English for the whole of the Federal Administration . Resource Sector Digital Services Section The provides IT and telecommunications support in the Federal Chancellery . HR , Finance , Controlling Section The forms part of the resources hub in Internal Services and provides vital support to all sections in the Federal Chancellery . Business Administration , Security , Infrastructure Section The section provides service support for records and process management and logistics in the Federal Chancellery and Federal Administration . Digital Transformation and ICT Steering Sector DTI Sector As of the beginning of 2021 , the Federal Chancellery is responsible for digital transformation and ICT steering . The task of the is to ensure the cross - departmental coordination of projects , resources and administrative services to advance the digital transformation process within the Federal Administration . Federal Chancellor ' s staff office Federal Chancellor ' s staff office The provides support in organisational and administrative matters , and in preparing Federal Council meetings and the follow - up work to the meetings . Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner The has two areas of responsibility : the Federal Act on Data Protection and the Federal Act on Freedom of Information in the Administration . Secteur du chancelier Section des droits politiques La est charg\u00e9e de mettre en \u0153uvre les droits populaires , de pr\u00e9parer les scrutins f\u00e9d\u00e9raux et de coordonner la mise en place du vote \u00e9lectronique par les cantons . Secteur communication et strat\u00e9gie Section communication La section communication de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale coordonne les informations du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral destin\u00e9es aux m\u00e9dias , au grand public , aux cantons et au Parlement . Section de soutien \u00e0 la communication La section est l ' agence de communication de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . La section est \u00e9galement responsable de la gestion et du d\u00e9veloppement strat\u00e9gique et op\u00e9rationnel du corporate design de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Section aide \u00e0 la conduite strat\u00e9gique La section Aide \u00e0 la conduite strat\u00e9gique ( SACS ) est charg\u00e9e d\u2019\u00e9tablir les rapports d\u2019activit\u00e9 et les rapports de planification du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et soutient les d\u00e9partements dans la gestion de crises . Service pr\u00e9sidentiel Le service pr\u00e9sidentiel , rattach\u00e9 depuis 2015 \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , assiste le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , et son d\u00e9partement , dans l\u2019accomplissement des t\u00e2ches suppl\u00e9mentaires qui lui incombent pendant l\u2019ann\u00e9e o\u00f9 il exerce cette fonction . Il joue un r\u00f4le de conseil notamment en mati\u00e8re de diplomatie et de communication . Secteur Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Section Affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral La Section des affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral traite les quelque 2 ' 500 affaires que les d\u00e9partements soumettent annuellement au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Elle traite en outre les quelque 1300 interventions parlementaires auxquelles le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral doit annuellement r\u00e9pondre . Section du droit Les activit\u00e9s de la section du droit se subdivisent en trois domaines : 1 . L\u00e9gislation et suivi des affaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral 2 . Domaines de comp\u00e9tence particuliers : droit du domaine de l\u2019organisation de l\u2019administration , de la consultation et des publications officielles . 3 . Autres t\u00e2ches : conseiller la direction et les sections sur toutes les questions juridiques et notamment sur la mise en \u0153uvre de la loi sur la protection des donn\u00e9es et de la loi sur la transparence , participer \u00e0 des projets au sein et en dehors de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , assurer la coordination dans le domaine des commissions extraparlementaires . Centre des publications officielles ( CPO ) Le soutient et conseille les offices f\u00e9d\u00e9raux dans le cadre du traitement des dossiers qui doivent \u00eatre publi\u00e9s dans la Feuille F\u00e9d\u00e9rale ou dans le Recueil officiel . Services linguistiques centraux , Section allemande La Section allemande des Services linguistiques centraux veille \u00e0 ce que tous les actes normatifs de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration soient formul\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re pr\u00e9cise , claire , coh\u00e9rente et aussi simple que possible . Services linguistiques centraux , Section fran\u00e7aise La Section fran\u00e7aise des Services linguistiques centraux partage ses activit\u00e9s entre r\u00e9daction l\u00e9gislative , traduction et r\u00e9vision pour le compte du Parlement , du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , des d\u00e9partements et de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Services linguistiques centraux , Division italienne C\u2019est \u00e0 la Division italienne qu\u2019incombe l\u2019\u00e9laboration de la version italienne de la l\u00e9gislation f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . A ce titre , elle est charg\u00e9e de la publication de l\u2019\u00e9dition en langue italienne de la Feuille f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et du Recueil officiel des lois f\u00e9d\u00e9rales . Services linguistiques centraux , Section de terminologie La Section de terminologie des Services linguistiques centraux de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale \u00e9labore pour toute l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale une terminologie actualis\u00e9e et adapt\u00e9e dans les quatre langues nationales et en anglais . Secteur Ressources Section Service num\u00e9riques La met son savoir \u00e0 la disposition de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et lui fournit les prestations en informatique et en t\u00e9l\u00e9communication n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 l\u2019accomplissement de ses t\u00e2ches . Section Personnel , finances , contr\u00f4le de gestion La Section est responsable de la gestion du personnel , de la formation , de la planification des finances et de la pr\u00e9sentation des comptes . Service sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 charg\u00e9 des contr\u00f4les de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 relatifs aux personnes Les cadres sup\u00e9rieurs de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sont soumis \u00e0 un contr\u00f4le de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 . Ce contr\u00f4le repose principalement sur une audition men\u00e9e par le Service sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale charg\u00e9 des contr\u00f4les de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 relatifs aux personnes . Section Gestion des affaires , s\u00e9curit\u00e9 , infrastructure La section fournit des prestations en faveur de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale dans les domaines de la gestion des affaires et de la logistique . Secteur Transformation num\u00e9rique et gouvernance de l\u2019informatique Transformation num\u00e9rique et gouvernance de l\u2019informatique ( TNI ) Depuis d\u00e9but 2021 , le secteur est rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Il assure la coordination interd\u00e9partementale des projets , des moyens et des prestations administratives dans la perspective de la transformation num\u00e9rique de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . L\u2019\u00e9tat - major du chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration L\u2019\u00e9tat - major du chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration est charg\u00e9 de soutenir le chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et les vice - chanceliers pour toutes les questions d\u2019ordre organisationnel ou administratif . Pr\u00e9pos\u00e9 f\u00e9d\u00e9ral \u00e0 la protection des donn\u00e9es et \u00e0 la transparence Le exerce ses comp\u00e9tences dans les domaines de la loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur la protection des donn\u00e9es et de la loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur le principe de la transparence dans l ' administration . Organisations interd\u00e9partementales Conf\u00e9rence des secr\u00e9taires g\u00e9n\u00e9raux ( CSG ) Conf\u00e9rence des services d\u2019information de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration ( CSIC ) Webforum de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration Conf\u00e9rence interd\u00e9partementale des services linguistiques ( CISL ) Informations compl\u00e9mentaires Documents Organigramme ChF d\u00e8s 01 . 10 . 2024 ( PDF , 105 kB , 30 . 09 . 2024 ) Liens Bases l\u00e9gales

sentence1: Jury Selection of projects , players and organisations for the Watt d ' Or award The Swiss Federal Office of Energy appoints a team of nominators for each category . They accept proposals and are also responsible for searching for projects that appear suitable . Each nominator is an expert in his or her own area , and undertakes an obligation to observe neutrality . Nominators select the best projects from all those resulting from their own research or proposals by third parties . They then submit their selection , together with their written comments , to the jury for evaluation . Members of the jury The proposals examined by the team of nominators are submitted to a jury for evaluation . The jury then chooses the best proposals . The members of the jury are qualified and well - known figures from a variety of areas , including research , cantonal authorities , the economy , architecture , trade and industry associations , environmental associations . Members of the jury for Watt d ' Or 2024 ( in alphabetical order ) : Last modification 28 . 06 . 2023
sentence2: Jury S\u00e9lection des projets , des personnes et des organisations m\u00e9ritant une distinction L ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie OFEN d\u00e9signe pour chaque cat\u00e9gorie un group de nomination charg\u00e9 de recevoir les propositions correspondantes et de rechercher aussi de leur c\u00f4t\u00e9 des projets paraissant appropri\u00e9s . Les nominateurs sont des sp\u00e9cialistes reconnus dans leur domaine et s ' engagent \u00e0 faire preuve d ' impartialit\u00e9 dans cette activit\u00e9 . Les nominateurs s\u00e9lectionnent les meilleurs projets parmi ceux qu ' ils ont eux - m\u00eames recherch\u00e9s ou qui ont \u00e9t\u00e9 propos\u00e9s par d ' autres et les pr\u00e9sentent au jury pour \u00e9valuation avec un commentaire \u00e9crit . Membres du jury Les propositions examin\u00e9es par les nominateurs sont pr\u00e9sent\u00e9es \u00e0 un jury pour \u00e9valuation . Le jury choisit les meilleurs projets . Les membres du jury sont des repr\u00e9sentants comp\u00e9tents et renomm\u00e9s de la recherche , des cantons , de l ' \u00e9conomie , de l ' architecture , d ' associations professionnelles et d ' organisations environnementales . Membres du jury pour Watt d ' Or 2024 par ordre alphab\u00e9tique : Derni\u00e8re modification 28 . 06 . 2023

sentence1: Driving Urban Transitions ( DUT ) The Driving Urban Transitions ( DUT ) Partnership steps up the game to tackle urban challenges . Through research and innovation ( R & I ) , it enables local authorities and municipalities , business , and citizens to translate global strategies into local action . DUT develops the skills and tools to make urban change happen and boosts the urgently needed urban transformation towards a sustainable future with enhanced quality of life in cities . DUT is realised as a European partnership of more than 60 partners from 27 countries , involving national and regional policy makers , funders and urban - related policy agencies to invest in urban R & I and strengthen a European innovation eco - system for urban transitions . Building upon the JPI Urban Europe achievements , DUT aims to create a strong community around urban transitions and to establish a well - known research and innovation platform that will help cities become more sustainable , inclusive and livable . DUT is addressing urban development in its complexity , with a close link to the European mission of 100 climate - neutral and smart cities . Transition Pathways Our future relies on tackling complex grand challenges here and now , many of which must be addressed within cities and by urban communities . The DUT partnership therefore aims to address these challenges with an integrated approach to offer decision makers in municipalities , companies and society the means to act and enable the necessary urban transformations . In order to support cities along their specific strategies , the Partnership focuses on three critical urban sectors and their interrelationships . The Positive Energy Districts transition pathway ( PED ) aims to optimise the local energy system through energy efficiency , flexibility and local energy generation from renewables in actions towards the ( urban ) energy transition and climate - neutrality and mainstreaming these actions in urban planning processes . PED development strongly builds on the cooperation of key stakeholder groups like public administrations , real estate developers and utilities . PED aims at supporting urban energy transitions through innovative solutions for the planning , large - scale implementation , and replication of PEDs with the mission to bring forward at least 100 PEDs by 2025 . Furthermore , it will contribute to the Mission on Climate - Neutral and Smart Cities by building a portfolio of PED - related solutions towards climate - neutrality . The 15 - Minute City transition pathway focusses on rethinking the existing mobility system and urban morphology to encourage sustainable mobility choices , redistribute urban space and reorganise our daily activities so to make our cities more climate neutral , livable and inclusive . The concept of the 15 - Minute City is based on the idea that city dwellers should be able to cover the vast majority of their daily needs within a 15 - minute radius , by walking and cycling , while connecting to further districts and travelling larger distances by other forms of sustainable transport . The 15minC mission is to facilitate analysis , elaboration , experimenting and testing of innovations for 15 - minute cities in co - creative settings , bringing these together in a 15 - minute City innovation portfolio of 50 + experiences and practices , recognising different urban contexts and focusing on transferability . The Circular Urban Economies Transition Pathway ( CUE ) wants to foster the design of urban places characterized by regenerative urbanism , by which we mean liveable , inclusive , and green communities and neighbourhoods that are sustained by circular urban economies and resource flows . Participating Swiss organizations The Swiss Federal Office of Energy ( SFOE ) , Innosuisse , the Swiss Science National Foundation ( SNSF ) as well as the Federal of Civil Aviation ( FOCA ) joined DUT . Swiss based applicants can join research consortia on equal terms with applicants from EU Member States and other Associated Partners . DUT Call 2023 The second DUT call has been launched on 1st September . The SFOE participates in the PED und 15mC transition pathways . The SFOE supports succesful Swiss partners with up to 4 million Euro through its Pilot - and Demonstration Programme ( P + D ) . The specific conditions of the DUT call as well as the P + D Programme apply . Please consider the documents below and on the DUT website . sentence1: The Energy label for cars The energy label provides information about the fuel consumption ( in litres per 100 kilometres ) , CO2 emissions ( in grams per kilometre ) and the energy efficiency of the vehicle . It contributes to reducing the average fuel consumption of new cars . The label must be displayed in a clearly visible manner directly on the vehicle or in its immediate vicinity . The details included in the label as well as some further information also have to be displayed in advertisements , in online configuration tools and in sales material . The label increases the degree of transparency for buyers of new cars , and thus helps them decide which model to buy . This decision has a direct influence on the operating costs , and in particular on the ongoing fuel and electricity costs .
